```python
"""Organiser reports as CSV (Excel-friendly, UTF-8 with BOM) and PDF.

    filename, data, content_type = build(ev, "final", "pdf")
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
from collections import Counter
from typing import Optional

from .. import catalog, db, events
from ..views.forms import fmt_date, fmt_dt, fmt_time
from .pdf import PDF

KINDS = {
    "guests": ("Complete guest list", "Everyone on the list with contact details, status, party size and table."),
    "rsvp": ("RSVP report", "Every response with plus-ones, children, meal and requests."),
    "seating": ("Seating chart", "Tables, occupancy and who sits where."),
    "dietary": ("Dietary report", "Dietary requirements and allergies of attending guests, for the caterer."),
    "meals": ("Meal selection report", "Meal choice counts and each guest's selection."),
    "outstanding": ("Outstanding RSVP report", "Guests who haven't replied yet, with contact details."),
    "final": ("Final event administration report", "Totals, guests, meals, dietary needs, requests and seating in one document."),
}
FORMATS = ("csv", "pdf")
STATUS = {"attending": "Attending", "declined": "Declined", "pending": "Pending"}


def _guests(event_id: int):
    return db.q("""SELECT g.*, m.name AS meal_name, t.name AS table_name
                   FROM guests g
                   LEFT JOIN menu_items m ON m.id = g.meal_item_id
                   LEFT JOIN seat_assignments a ON a.guest_id = g.id
                   LEFT JOIN seating_tables t ON t.id = a.table_id
                   WHERE g.event_id = ?
                   ORDER BY g.last_name COLLATE NOCASE, g.first_name COLLATE NOCASE""", (event_id,))


def _csv(headers: list, rows: list) -> bytes:
    buf = io.StringIO()
    w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator="\r\n")
    w.writerow(headers)
    for r in rows:
        w.writerow(["" if v is None else _safe_cell(v) for v in r])
    return ("﻿" + buf.getvalue()).encode("utf-8")


def _safe_cell(v):
    """Neutralise spreadsheet formula injection in text cells."""
    if isinstance(v, str) and v[:1] in ("=", "+", "-", "@") and not v[1:].replace(".", "").isdigit():
        return "'" + v
    return v


def _subtitle(ev) -> str:
    bits = [events.title(ev)]
    if ev.get("event_date"):
        bits.append(fmt_date(ev["event_date"]))
    venue = (ev.get("venue") or {}).get("name")
    if venue:
        bits.append(venue)
    return " · ".join(bits)


def _party(g) -> int:
    return events.party_size(g) if g["status"] != "declined" else 0


def _totals(ev) -> list:
    s = events.stats(ev["id"])
    return [("Total invited", s["invited"]), ("Confirmed", s["attending"]), ("Declined", s["declined"]),
            ("Pending RSVPs", s["pending"]), ("Plus-ones attending", s["plus_ones"]),
            ("Children attending", s["children"]), ("Total headcount", s["headcount"]),
            ("RSVP completion", f"{s['completion']}%")]


def _table_rows(ev):
    tables = events.tables(ev["id"])
    seated = {}
    for r in db.q("""SELECT a.table_id, g.* FROM seat_assignments a JOIN guests g ON g.id = a.guest_id
                     WHERE a.event_id = ? ORDER BY g.last_name COLLATE NOCASE, g.first_name COLLATE NOCASE""", (ev["id"],)):
        seated.setdefault(r["table_id"], []).append(r)
    return tables, seated


def build(ev: dict, kind: str, fmt: str, user_id: Optional[int] = None, delivered: str = "download"):
    if kind not in KINDS or fmt not in FORMATS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown report")
    if not isinstance(ev, dict) or not isinstance(ev.get("venue"), dict):
        ev = events.by_id(ev["id"])
    title, _ = KINDS[kind]
    guests = _guests(ev["id"])
    filename = f"{ev['slug']}-{kind}.{fmt}"
    data = _BUILDERS[kind](ev, guests, fmt, title)
    if user_id is not None:
        db.insert("report_runs", {"event_id": ev["id"], "user_id": user_id, "kind": kind, "format": fmt,
                                  "delivered": delivered, "created_at": db.now()})
    ctype = "text/csv; charset=utf-8" if fmt == "csv" else "application/pdf"
    return filename, data, ctype


# --- builders ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _b_guests(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    headers = ["First name", "Last name", "Email", "Phone", "Category", "Family group", "Side", "VIP", "Child",
               "Status", "Plus-ones", "Children", "Party size", "Table", "Checked in"]
    rows = [[g["first_name"], g["last_name"], g["email"], g["phone"], g["category"], g["family_group"], g["side"],
             "Yes" if g["is_vip"] else "", "Yes" if g["is_child"] else "", STATUS[g["status"]], g["plus_ones"],
             g["children"], _party(g), g["table_name"] or "", "Yes" if g["checked_in_at"] else ""] for g in guests]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(headers, rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.kv(_totals(ev)[:4])
    doc.table(["Name", "Contact", "Category", "Status", "Party", "Table"],
              [[events.guest_name(g) + (" (VIP)" if g["is_vip"] else ""), g["email"] or g["phone"],
                " / ".join(x for x in (g["category"], g["family_group"]) if x), STATUS[g["status"]], _party(g),
                g["table_name"] or ""] for g in guests], [2.2, 2.4, 1.8, 1.1, .7, 1.2])
    return doc.output()


def _b_rsvp(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    headers = ["Name", "Status", "Responded", "Plus-ones", "Plus-one names", "Children", "Meal", "Dietary",
               "Allergies", "Special requests", "Source"]
    rows = [[events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], fmt_dt(g["responded_at"]), g["plus_ones"], g["plus_one_names"],
             g["children"], g["meal_name"] or "", g["dietary"], g["allergies"], g["special_requests"],
             {"general_link": "General link", "import": "Imported"}.get(g["source"], "Organiser")] for g in guests]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(headers, rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.kv(_totals(ev))
    for status in ("attending", "declined", "pending"):
        subset = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == status]
        doc.heading(f"{STATUS[status]} ({len(subset)})")
        doc.table(["Name", "Replied", "+1", "Kids", "Meal", "Notes"],
                  [[events.guest_name(g), fmt_dt(g["responded_at"]), g["plus_ones"] or "", g["children"] or "",
                    g["meal_name"] or "", "; ".join(x for x in (g["dietary"], g["allergies"], g["special_requests"]) if x)]
                   for g in subset], [2, 1.6, .5, .5, 1.6, 3])
    return doc.output()


def _b_seating(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    tables, seated = _table_rows(ev)
    if fmt == "csv":
        rows = []
        for t in tables:
            people = seated.get(t["id"], [])
            if not people:
                rows.append([t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], "", "", ""])
            for g in people:
                rows.append([t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], _party(g)])
        assigned = {g["id"] for ps in seated.values() for g in ps}
        for g in guests:
            if g["status"] == "attending" and g["id"] not in assigned:
                rows.append(["Unassigned", "", "", events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], _party(g)])
        return _csv(["Table", "Capacity", "Seated", "Guest", "Status", "Party size"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.table(["Table", "Capacity", "Seated", "Free"],
              [[t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], _free(t)] for t in tables],
              [3, 1, 1, 1])
    for t in tables:
        people = seated.get(t["id"], [])
        doc.heading(f"{t['name']}  ·  {t['seated']} of {t['capacity']}")
        if t["notes"]:
            doc.text(t["notes"], 9, muted=True)
        doc.table(["Guest", "Party", "Meal / dietary"],
                  [[events.guest_name(g) + (f" + {g['plus_one_names'] or g['plus_ones']}" if g["plus_ones"] else ""),
                    _party(g), "; ".join(x for x in (_meal(g), g["dietary"], g["allergies"]) if x)] for g in people],
                  [3, .8, 3])
    assigned = {g["id"] for ps in seated.values() for g in ps}
    loose = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending" and g["id"] not in assigned]
    if loose:
        doc.heading(f"Not yet seated ({len(loose)})")
        doc.table(["Guest", "Party"], [[events.guest_name(g), _party(g)] for g in loose], [4, 1])
    return doc.output()


def _free(t) -> str:
    free = t["capacity"] - t["seated"]
    return str(free) if free >= 0 else f"Over by {-free}"


def _att(g, key):
    return (g[key] or "") if g["status"] == "attending" else ""


def _meal(g):
    try:
        return g["meal_name"] or ""
    except (IndexError, KeyError):
        row = db.one("SELECT name FROM menu_items WHERE id = ?", (g["meal_item_id"],)) if g["meal_item_id"] else None
        return row["name"] if row else ""


def _b_dietary(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    subset = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending" and (g["dietary"] or g["allergies"])]
    rows = [[events.guest_name(g), g["dietary"], g["allergies"], g["meal_name"] or "", g["table_name"] or ""] for g in subset]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(["Guest", "Dietary requirements", "Allergies", "Meal", "Table"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    counts = Counter()
    for g in subset:
        for part in (g["dietary"] or "").split(","):
            if part.strip():
                counts[part.strip()] += 1
    if counts:
        doc.kv([(k, v) for k, v in counts.most_common()])
    doc.table(["Guest", "Dietary", "Allergies", "Meal", "Table"], rows, [2, 2, 2, 1.6, 1])
    return doc.output()


def _b_meals(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    attending = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending"]
    counts = Counter(g["meal_name"] or "No selection" for g in attending)
    options = [m["name"] for m in events.meal_options(ev["id"])]
    for o in options:
        counts.setdefault(o, 0)
    if fmt == "csv":
        rows = [["Count", k, v, ""] for k, v in sorted(counts.items())]
        rows += [["Guest", events.guest_name(g), g["meal_name"] or "No selection", g["dietary"]] for g in attending]
        return _csv(["Row type", "Name", "Meal / count", "Dietary"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.heading("Totals")
    doc.kv([(k, v) for k, v in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])])
    doc.heading("By guest")
    doc.table(["Guest", "Meal", "Dietary", "Table"],
              [[events.guest_name(g), g["meal_name"] or "No selection", g["dietary"], g["table_name"] or ""] for g in attending],
              [2, 2, 2, 1])
    return doc.output()


def _b_outstanding(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    subset = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "pending"]
    rows = [[events.guest_name(g), g["email"], g["phone"], g["category"], g["family_group"], fmt_dt(g["invited_at"]),
             events.invite_url(ev, g)] for g in subset]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(["Guest", "Email", "Phone", "Category", "Family group", "Invited", "Personal link"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    deadline = (ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("rsvp_deadline")
    doc.text(f"{len(subset)} guests haven't replied." + (f" RSVP deadline: {fmt_date(deadline)}." if deadline else ""))
    doc.table(["Guest", "Email", "Phone", "Group"], [r[:4] for r in rows], [2, 2.6, 1.6, 1.4])
    return doc.output()


def _b_final(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    tables, seated = _table_rows(ev)
    attending = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending"]
    meal_counts = Counter(g["meal_name"] or "No selection" for g in attending)
    if fmt == "csv":
        rows = [["Summary", k, v, "", "", "", "", "", ""] for k, v in _totals(ev)]
        rows += [["Meal total", k, v, "", "", "", "", "", ""] for k, v in sorted(meal_counts.items())]
        rows += [["Table", t["name"], f"{t['seated']} of {t['capacity']}", "", "", "", "", "", ""] for t in tables]
        rows += [["Guest", events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], g["plus_ones"], g["children"], g["meal_name"] or "",
                  "; ".join(x for x in (g["dietary"], g["allergies"]) if x), g["special_requests"], g["table_name"] or ""]
                 for g in guests]
        return _csv(["Section", "Name", "Status / value", "Plus-ones", "Children", "Meal", "Dietary and allergies",
                     "Special requests", "Table"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    venue = ev.get("venue") or {}
    doc.kv([("Event", ev["name"]), ("Date", fmt_date(ev.get("event_date")) or "To be confirmed"),
            ("Time", " to ".join(x for x in (fmt_time(ev.get("start_time")), fmt_time(ev.get("end_time"))) if x) or "To be confirmed"),
            ("Venue", ", ".join(x for x in (venue.get("name"), venue.get("address")) if x) or "To be confirmed")])
    doc.heading("Totals")
    doc.kv(_totals(ev))
    doc.heading("Meal selections")
    doc.kv([(k, v) for k, v in sorted(meal_counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])] or [("Meals", "No selections yet")])
    if catalog.has_feature(ev, "detailed_reports"):
        doc.heading("By guest category")
        cats = Counter((g["category"] or "Uncategorised") for g in attending)
        doc.kv([(k, f"{v} attending") for k, v in cats.most_common()] or [("Categories", "None")])
    doc.heading("Table occupancy")
    doc.table(["Table", "Capacity", "Seated", "Free"],
              [[t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], _free(t)] for t in tables], [3, 1, 1, 1])
    doc.heading("Guests")
    doc.table(["Guest", "Status", "+1", "Kids", "Meal", "Dietary / allergies", "Requests", "Table"],
              [[events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], _att(g, "plus_ones"), _att(g, "children"), g["meal_name"] or "",
                "; ".join(x for x in (g["dietary"], g["allergies"]) if x), g["special_requests"], g["table_name"] or ""]
               for g in guests], [1.8, 1, .45, .6, 1.3, 1.6, 1.6, 1])
    return doc.output()


_BUILDERS = {"guests": _b_guests, "rsvp": _b_rsvp, "seating": _b_seating, "dietary": _b_dietary,
             "meals": _b_meals, "outstanding": _b_outstanding, "final": _b_final}


def final_attachments(ev, user_id: Optional[int] = None) -> list:
    out = []
    for fmt in ("pdf", "csv"):
        name, data, ctype = build(ev, "final", fmt, user_id=user_id, delivered="email")
        out.append((name, data, ctype.split(";")[0]))
    return out
```

### `app/services/scheduler.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/scheduler.py sha256=22d40d5daf8515e28d738224260a099269176d3c33260aad648358d02f03e7c9 nl=1 -->
```python
"""Background jobs: RSVP summaries, reminders, post-event reports, hosting expiry, clean-up.

`loop()` runs in a daemon thread started by run.py. `run_once(today)` does one pass and is
safe to repeat: every email is guarded by a sent_markers row (event_id, marker), so a job that
already ran for a period, guest or date never sends twice. Demo events never get emails and
suspended events are skipped entirely.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import sys
import time
import traceback
from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import Optional

from .. import catalog, config, db, events, notify
from . import email as mail


def mark(event_id: int, marker: str) -> bool:
    """Claim a marker. True the first time (go ahead and send), False if already claimed."""
    try:
        cur = db.connect().execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sent_markers (event_id, marker, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (event_id, marker, db.now()))
        return cur.rowcount == 1
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return False


def _date(value) -> Optional[date]:
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(str(value)[:10])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _email_events() -> list:
    rows = db.q("SELECT * FROM events WHERE is_demo = 0 AND status != 'suspended' AND paid_package IS NOT NULL")
    return [events.parse(r) for r in rows]


def _summaries(ev, today: date) -> int:
    prefs = ev.get("report_prefs") or {}
    freq = prefs.get("summary", "none")
    event_day = _date(ev.get("event_date"))
    if not events.is_live(ev) or freq not in ("daily", "weekly") or (event_day and event_day < today):
        return 0
    if freq == "daily":
        marker, since = f"summary-d-{today.isoformat()}", today - timedelta(days=1)
    else:
        if today.weekday() != 0:
            return 0
        y, w, _ = today.isocalendar()
        marker, since = f"summary-w-{y}-{w:02d}", today - timedelta(days=7)
    if not mark(ev["id"], marker):
        return 0
    st = events.stats(ev["id"])
    new_count = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvp_responses WHERE event_id = ? AND created_at >= ?",
                       (ev["id"], since.isoformat()), 0)
    notify.organiser(ev, "rsvp_summary", {"summary_table": notify.summary_table_html(st),
                                          "completion": st["completion"], "new_count": new_count})
    return 1


def _outstanding(ev, today: date) -> int:
    deadline = _date((ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("rsvp_deadline"))
    if not deadline or not events.is_live(ev):
        return 0
    days = (deadline - today).days
    if days not in (7, 2):
        return 0
    st = events.stats(ev["id"])
    if st["pending"] <= 0 or not mark(ev["id"], f"outstanding-{days}-{deadline.isoformat()}"):
        return 0
    notify.organiser(ev, "outstanding_reminder", {"pending": st["pending"]})
    return 1


def _auto_guest_reminders(ev, today: date) -> int:
    prefs = ev.get("report_prefs") or {}
    if not prefs.get("auto_reminders") or not events.is_live(ev) or not catalog.has_feature(ev, "reminders", public=True):
        return 0
    deadline = _date((ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("rsvp_deadline"))
    if not deadline or not (0 <= (deadline - today).days <= 5):
        return 0
    used, allowed = events.email_quota(ev)
    sent = 0
    base = notify.event_vars(ev)
    for g in db.q("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id", (ev["id"],)):
        if used >= allowed:
            break
        if not notify.can_email_guest(g):
            continue
        if not mark(ev["id"], f"auto-remind-{g['id']}"):
            continue
        result = mail.send(g["email"], "guest_reminder", {**base, **notify.guest_vars(ev, g)},
                           event_id=ev["id"], guest_id=g["id"], batch_id=f"auto-{today.isoformat()}")
        if result["status"] == "sent":
            used += 1
            sent += 1
    return sent


def _event_reminders(ev, today: date) -> int:
    event_day = _date(ev.get("event_date"))
    if not event_day:
        return 0
    days = (event_day - today).days
    if days not in (7, 1) or not mark(ev["id"], f"event-reminder-{days}-{event_day.isoformat()}"):
        return 0
    text = "Tomorrow" if days == 1 else f"{days} days to go"
    lower = "tomorrow" if days == 1 else f"in {days} days"
    notify.organiser(ev, "event_reminder", {"days_text": text, "days_text_lower": lower})
    return 1


def _post_event(ev, today: date) -> int:
    event_day = _date(ev.get("event_date"))
    if not event_day or not (1 <= (today - event_day).days <= 3):
        return 0
    if not mark(ev["id"], "post-event"):
        return 0
    attachments = []
    try:
        from . import reports  # built by the organiser-dashboard module
        attachments = list(reports.final_attachments(ev) or [])
    except ImportError:
        attachments = []
    except Exception:  # a broken report must not stop the email
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        attachments = []
    st = events.stats(ev["id"])
    notify.organiser(ev, "post_event", {"summary_table": notify.summary_table_html(st)}, attachments=attachments)
    return 1


def _expire_hosting(today: date) -> int:
    rows = db.q("SELECT id, uid FROM events WHERE status = 'published' AND hosting_until IS NOT NULL AND hosting_until < ?",
                (today.isoformat(),))
    for r in rows:
        events.touch(r["id"], status="unpublished")
        db.insert("audit_log", {"actor_id": None, "action": "event.hosting_expired", "target": r["uid"], "meta": "{}",
                                "created_at": db.now()})
    return len(rows)


def _prune() -> int:
    now = db.now()
    c = db.connect()
    n = c.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < ?", (now,)).rowcount
    n += c.execute("DELETE FROM user_tokens WHERE expires_at < ? OR used_at IS NOT NULL", (now,)).rowcount
    return n


JOBS = [("summaries", _summaries), ("outstanding", _outstanding), ("guest_reminders", _auto_guest_reminders),
        ("event_reminders", _event_reminders), ("post_event", _post_event)]


def run_once(today: Optional[date] = None) -> dict:
    today = today or date.today()
    counts = {name: 0 for name, _ in JOBS}
    for ev in _email_events():
        for name, job in JOBS:
            try:
                counts[name] += job(ev, today)
            except Exception:
                print(f"[scheduler] {name} failed for event {ev['uid']}", file=sys.stderr)
                traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
    counts["hosting_expired"] = _expire_hosting(today)
    counts["pruned"] = _prune()
    return counts


def loop() -> None:
    while True:
        try:
            counts = run_once()
            if any(counts.values()) and config.DEBUG:
                print(f"[scheduler] {counts}", file=sys.stderr)
        except Exception:
            traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        time.sleep(max(30, config.SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS))
```

### `app/services/storage.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/storage.py sha256=db342dbe8cfed37515d9aa378b2f5bf903439a6a64e831cf59a9410ff6a9e7eb nl=1 -->
```python
"""Image uploads behind a storage interface.

`LocalStorage` keeps files under data/uploads/. A cloud backend (S3, R2, GCS) only needs the
same three methods; set STORAGE_BACKEND once one is added. Files are validated by their
leading bytes (not the browser's claimed type), size-limited and stored under random names.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import secrets
from typing import Optional

from .. import config, db

SIGNATURES = [
    (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "image/png", "png"),
    (b"\xff\xd8\xff", "image/jpeg", "jpg"),
    (b"GIF87a", "image/gif", "gif"),
    (b"GIF89a", "image/gif", "gif"),
]


class UploadError(Exception):
    pass


def sniff(data: bytes) -> Optional[tuple[str, str]]:
    for sig, mime, ext in SIGNATURES:
        if data.startswith(sig):
            return mime, ext
    if data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP":
        return "image/webp", "webp"
    return None


class LocalStorage:
    root = config.UPLOAD_DIR

    def put(self, key: str, data: bytes) -> None:
        path = (self.root / key).resolve()
        path.relative_to(self.root.resolve())
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(data)

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
        path = (self.root / key).resolve()
        try:
            path.relative_to(self.root.resolve())
        except ValueError:
            return None
        return path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None

    def delete(self, key: str) -> None:
        path = (self.root / key).resolve()
        try:
            path.relative_to(self.root.resolve())
        except ValueError:
            return
        if path.is_file():
            path.unlink()


storage = LocalStorage()


def save_image(upload, event, user_id: Optional[int], kind: str, caption: str = "") -> dict:
    if upload is None or not upload.data:
        raise UploadError("Choose an image to upload.")
    if upload.size > config.MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:
        raise UploadError(f"Images must be {config.MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES // (1024 * 1024)} MB or smaller.")
    kind_info = sniff(upload.data)
    if not kind_info:
        raise UploadError("Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.")
    mime, ext = kind_info
    key = f"{event['uid']}/{kind}-{secrets.token_hex(10)}.{ext}"
    storage.put(key, upload.data)
    sort = db.val("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort), 0) + 1 FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ? AND kind = ?",
                  (event["id"], kind), 1)
    up_id = db.insert("uploads", {"event_id": event["id"], "user_id": user_id, "kind": kind, "storage_key": key,
                                  "mime": mime, "size": upload.size, "caption": caption[:200], "sort": sort,
                                  "created_at": db.now()})
    return dict(db.one("SELECT * FROM uploads WHERE id = ?", (up_id,)))


def delete_upload(upload_id: int, event_id: int) -> bool:
    row = db.one("SELECT * FROM uploads WHERE id = ? AND event_id = ?", (upload_id, event_id))
    if not row:
        return False
    storage.delete(row["storage_key"])
    db.run("DELETE FROM uploads WHERE id = ?", (upload_id,))
    return True
```

```python
"""Registration, login, logout, password reset, email verification and the account page."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from .. import auth, config, db
from ..icons import i
from ..services import email as mail
from ..web import Response, download, esc, redirect, router, safe_next, url
from . import forms
from .forms import Form, csrf, errors_summary, field, honeypot
from .layout import bare
from .shell import account_page, page_head

AUTH_QUOTES = [
    "One event. One platform. One link.",
    "Invitations, RSVPs, menus and seating, organised in one place.",
]


def auth_layout(req, title: str, inner: str, quote: str = AUTH_QUOTES[0]) -> str:
    body = f"""<div class="auth"><div class="auth__form"><div>{inner}</div></div>
<div class="auth__art"><div class="grid-texture"></div><div class="auth__quote">
<p class="serif">{esc(quote)}</p><p class="muted" style="margin-top:18px">Everything for your event, in one place: the website, RSVPs, guest list, seating, menus and reports.</p>
<div class="glass panel" style="margin-top:32px;display:grid;gap:10px;max-width:360px">
<div class="row row--between small"><span>RSVPs</span><b class="mono">118 / 150</b></div>
<div class="progress"><span style="width:79%"></span></div>
<div class="row row--between tiny muted"><span>94 attending</span><span>24 declined</span><span>32 to reply</span></div></div>
</div></div></div>"""
    return bare(req, title, body)


def login_session(resp: Response, req, user_id: int) -> Response:
    token = auth.create_session(user_id, req.ip, req.headers.get("user-agent", ""))
    resp.set_cookie(auth.SESSION_COOKIE, token, max_age=config.SESSION_DAYS * 86400)
    return resp


def send_verification(user) -> None:
    token = auth.issue_token(user["id"], "verify", 48)
    mail.send(user["email"], "verify_email", {"first_name": mail.first_name(user["name"]),
                                              "verify_url": f"{config.BASE_URL}/verify/{token}"},
              user_id=user["id"])


# --- register --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/register", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def register(req):
    nxt = safe_next(req.arg("next") or req.get("next"), "/create")
    if req.user:
        return redirect(nxt)
    f = Form(req)
    if req.method == "POST":
        if req.get("website"):
            return redirect("/")
        if auth.rate_limited(f"register:{req.ip}", 10, 3600):
            f.error("email", "Too many sign-ups from this connection. Please try again in an hour.")
        name = f.text("name", "Your name", required=True, max=120, min=2)
        email = f.email("email", required=True)
        pw = req.get("password")
        if not pw:
            f.error("password", "Choose a password.")
        else:
            for p in auth.password_problems(pw, email):
                f.error("password", p)
                break
        if pw and req.get("password_confirm") != pw:
            f.error("password_confirm", "The passwords don't match.")
        if not f.flag("terms"):
            f.error("terms", "Please accept the terms and privacy notice to create an account.")
        if email and not f.errors.get("email") and db.one("SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)):
            f.error("email", "An account with this email already exists. Log in or reset your password.")
        if f.ok:
            uid = db.insert("users", {"email": email, "name": name, "password_hash": auth.hash_password(pw),
                                      "role": "customer", "marketing_consent": 1 if req.get("marketing") else 0,
                                      "created_at": db.now()})
            user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (uid,))
            mail.send(email, "welcome", {"first_name": mail.first_name(name)}, user_id=uid)
            send_verification(user)
            auth.audit(uid, "user.register", email)
            req.flash("success", f"Welcome, {mail.first_name(name)}. We've sent a link to confirm your email.")
            return login_session(redirect(nxt), req, uid)
    d = f.data
    inner = f"""<h1>Create your account</h1><p class="lead" style="margin:10px 0 28px;font-size:1rem">Save your event as you go and come back any time. Already registered? <a class="text-link" href="{url('/login', next=nxt)}">Log in</a>.</p>
<form class="form" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}{honeypot()}<input type="hidden" name="next" value="{esc(nxt)}">
{errors_summary(f.errors)}
{field("name", "Your name", d.get("name", ""), required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "name"})}
{field("email", "Email", d.get("email", ""), type="email", required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "email"})}
{field("password", "Password", "", type="password", required=True, errors=f.errors, hint="At least 10 characters, with upper- and lower-case letters and a number.", attrs={"autocomplete": "new-password"})}
{field("password_confirm", "Confirm password", "", type="password", required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "new-password"})}
<div class="field{' has-error' if 'terms' in f.errors else ''}">{forms.check("terms", 'I accept the <a class="text-link" href="/terms" target="_blank">terms of service</a> and the <a class="text-link" href="/privacy" target="_blank">privacy notice</a>.', bool(d.get("terms")))}</div>
{forms.check("marketing", "Send me occasional tips and new templates (optional).", bool(req.get("marketing")))}
<button class="btn btn--primary btn--lg btn--block" type="submit">Create account {i("arrow", "i--arrow")}</button></form>"""
    return auth_layout(req, "Create your account", inner)


# --- login / logout ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/login", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def login(req):
    nxt = safe_next(req.arg("next") or req.get("next"), "/dashboard")
    if req.user:
        return redirect(nxt)
    f = Form(req)
    if req.method == "POST":
        email = f.email("email", required=True)
        pw = req.get("password")
        key = f"login:{req.ip}:{email}"
        if auth.rate_limited(key, 8, 900) or auth.rate_limited(f"login-ip:{req.ip}", 40, 900):
            f.error("email", "Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes or reset your password.")
        elif f.ok:
            user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,))
            if user and auth.verify_password(pw, user["password_hash"]):
                if user["status"] != "active":
                    f.error("email", "This account is suspended. Contact support for help.")
                else:
                    auth.reset_rate(key)
                    return login_session(redirect(nxt), req, user["id"])
            else:
                f.error("password", "That email and password don't match an account.")
    inner = f"""<h1>Welcome back</h1><p class="lead" style="margin:10px 0 28px;font-size:1rem">Log in to continue your event. New here? <a class="text-link" href="{url('/register', next=nxt if nxt != '/dashboard' else '')}">Create an account</a>.</p>
<form class="form" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}<input type="hidden" name="next" value="{esc(nxt)}">{errors_summary(f.errors)}
{field("email", "Email", f.data.get("email", ""), type="email", required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "email", "autofocus": True})}
{field("password", "Password", "", type="password", required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "current-password"})}
<div class="row row--between"><a class="text-link small" href="/forgot-password">Forgot your password?</a></div>
<button class="btn btn--primary btn--lg btn--block" type="submit">Log in {i("arrow", "i--arrow")}</button></form>"""
    return auth_layout(req, "Log in", inner, AUTH_QUOTES[1])


@router.post("/logout")
def logout(req):
    auth.destroy_session(req.cookies.get(auth.SESSION_COOKIE, ""))
    resp = redirect("/")
    resp.set_cookie(auth.SESSION_COOKIE, "", max_age=0)
    return resp


# --- password reset ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/forgot-password", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def forgot(req):
    sent = False
    f = Form(req)
    if req.method == "POST":
        email = f.email("email", required=True)
        if f.ok and not auth.rate_limited(f"forgot:{req.ip}", 6, 3600):
            user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,))
            if user and user["status"] == "active":
                token = auth.issue_token(user["id"], "reset", 1)
                mail.send(email, "password_reset", {"first_name": mail.first_name(user["name"]),
                                                    "reset_url": f"{config.BASE_URL}/reset-password/{token}"},
                          user_id=user["id"])
            sent = True
        elif f.ok:
            sent = True
    if sent:
        inner = (f'<h1>Check your email</h1><p class="lead" style="margin:10px 0 24px;font-size:1rem">If an account exists for '
                 f'<b>{esc(f.data.get("email"))}</b>, we\'ve sent a link to choose a new password. It works once and expires in one hour.</p>'
                 f'<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="/login">Back to log in</a>')
    else:
        inner = f"""<h1>Reset your password</h1><p class="lead" style="margin:10px 0 28px;font-size:1rem">Enter the email you registered with and we'll send you a reset link.</p>
<form class="form" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}{errors_summary(f.errors)}
{field("email", "Email", f.data.get("email", ""), type="email", required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "email"})}
<button class="btn btn--primary btn--lg btn--block" type="submit">Send reset link</button></form>
<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:18px"><a class="text-link" href="/login">Back to log in</a></p>"""
    return auth_layout(req, "Reset your password", inner)


@router.route("/reset-password/<token>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def reset_password(req, token):
    user_id = auth.peek_token(token, "reset")
    if not user_id:
        inner = ('<h1>This link has expired</h1><p class="lead" style="margin:10px 0 24px;font-size:1rem">Reset links work once '
                 'and last one hour. Request a new one.</p><a class="btn btn--primary" href="/forgot-password">Request a new link</a>')
        return auth_layout(req, "Link expired", inner)
    user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
    f = Form(req)
    if req.method == "POST":
        pw = req.get("password")
        for p in auth.password_problems(pw, user["email"]):
            f.error("password", p)
            break
        if req.get("password_confirm") != pw:
            f.error("password_confirm", "The passwords don't match.")
        if f.ok and auth.consume_token(token, "reset"):
            db.run("UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?", (auth.hash_password(pw), user_id))
            auth.destroy_user_sessions(user_id)
            auth.audit(user_id, "user.password_reset", user["email"])
            req.flash("success", "Your password is updated. Log in with your new password.")
            return redirect("/login")
    inner = f"""<h1>Choose a new password</h1><p class="lead" style="margin:10px 0 28px;font-size:1rem">For {esc(user["email"])}. You'll be signed out on other devices.</p>
<form class="form" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}{errors_summary(f.errors)}
{field("password", "New password", "", type="password", required=True, errors=f.errors, hint="At least 10 characters, with upper- and lower-case letters and a number.", attrs={"autocomplete": "new-password"})}
{field("password_confirm", "Confirm new password", "", type="password", required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "new-password"})}
<button class="btn btn--primary btn--lg btn--block" type="submit">Save new password</button></form>"""
    return auth_layout(req, "Choose a new password", inner)


# --- email verification -----------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/verify/<token>")
def verify(req, token):
    user_id = auth.consume_token(token, "verify")
    if user_id:
        db.run("UPDATE users SET email_verified_at = COALESCE(email_verified_at, ?) WHERE id = ?", (db.now(), user_id))
        req.flash("success", "Thank you. Your email address is confirmed.")
        return redirect("/dashboard" if req.user else "/login")
    req.flash("error", "That confirmation link has expired or was already used.")
    return redirect("/account" if req.user else "/login")


@router.post("/account/verify")
def resend_verification(req):
    user = auth.require_user(req)
    if user["email_verified_at"]:
        req.flash("info", "Your email is already confirmed.")
    elif auth.rate_limited(f"verify:{user['id']}", 3, 3600):
        req.flash("error", "We've sent a few links already. Check your spam folder, or try again in an hour.")
    else:
        send_verification(user)
        req.flash("success", f"We've sent a new confirmation link to {user['email']}.")
    return redirect("/account")


# --- account page -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/account", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def account(req):
    user = auth.require_user(req)
    f = Form(req)
    pw = Form(req)
    action = req.get("action")
    if req.method == "POST" and action == "profile":
        name = f.text("name", "Your name", required=True, max=120, min=2)
        phone = f.phone("phone")
        if f.ok:
            db.run("UPDATE users SET name = ?, phone = ?, marketing_consent = ? WHERE id = ?",
                   (name, phone, 1 if req.get("marketing") else 0, user["id"]))
            req.flash("success", "Your details are saved.")
            return redirect("/account")
    if req.method == "POST" and action == "password":
        if not auth.verify_password(req.get("current"), user["password_hash"]):
            pw.error("current", "Your current password isn't right.")
        new = req.get("new")
        for p in auth.password_problems(new, user["email"]):
            pw.error("new", p)
            break
        if pw.ok:
            db.run("UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?", (auth.hash_password(new), user["id"]))
            db.run("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ? AND id != ?",
                   (user["id"], auth._sha(req.cookies.get(auth.SESSION_COOKIE, ""))))
            auth.audit(user["id"], "user.password_change", user["email"])
            req.flash("success", "Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.")
            return redirect("/account")
    if req.method == "POST" and action == "delete":
        if req.get("confirm_email", "").lower() != user["email"].lower():
            req.flash("error", "Type your email address exactly to confirm deletion.")
            return redirect("/account#delete")
        paid = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'paid'", (user["id"],), 0)
        if paid:
            db.insert("support_requests", {"user_id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "email": user["email"],
                                           "topic": "privacy", "message": "Account deletion requested (has paid orders; "
                                           "keep invoices for tax records, delete the rest).", "priority": 1,
                                           "created_at": db.now(), "updated_at": db.now()})
            req.flash("info", "We've logged your deletion request. Because you have paid orders, we keep invoices "
                              "for tax law and delete everything else within 30 days.")
            return redirect("/account")
        auth.audit(user["id"], "user.delete", user["email"])
        db.run("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user["id"],))
        resp = redirect("/")
        resp.set_cookie(auth.SESSION_COOKIE, "", max_age=0)
        return resp
    verified = (f'<span class="pill pill--ok">Confirmed</span>' if user["email_verified_at"] else
                f'<form method="post" action="/account/verify" class="row">{csrf(req)}<span class="pill pill--pending">Not confirmed</span>'
                f'<button class="btn btn--sm btn--secondary" type="submit">Resend link</button></form>')
    body = page_head("Account", "Your details, password and privacy choices.") + f"""
<div class="cols cols--even">
<section class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Your details</h2></div>
<form class="form" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}<input type="hidden" name="action" value="profile">{errors_summary(f.errors)}
{field("name", "Name", f.data.get("name", user["name"]), required=True, errors=f.errors)}
<div class="field"><span class="label">Email</span><div class="row"><span>{esc(user["email"])}</span>{verified}</div></div>
{field("phone", "Phone (optional)", f.data.get("phone", user["phone"] or ""), type="tel", errors=f.errors)}
{forms.check("marketing", "Send me occasional tips and new templates.", bool(user["marketing_consent"]))}
<div><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Save details</button></div></form></section>
<section class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Change password</h2></div>
<form class="form" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}<input type="hidden" name="action" value="password">{errors_summary(pw.errors)}
{field("current", "Current password", "", type="password", required=True, errors=pw.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "current-password"})}
{field("new", "New password", "", type="password", required=True, errors=pw.errors, hint="At least 10 characters, mixed case and a number.", attrs={"autocomplete": "new-password"})}
<div><button class="btn btn--secondary" type="submit">Change password</button></div></form></section>
<section class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Your data (POPIA)</h2></div>
<p class="muted small">You can download everything we hold about you and your events, or ask us to delete it. Guest information you add stays private to your events and is never sold or shared for marketing.</p>
<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:16px"><a class="btn btn--secondary" href="/account/export">{i("download")} Download my data</a><a class="text-link small" href="/privacy">Read the privacy notice</a></div></section>
<section class="box" id="delete"><div class="box__head"><h2>Delete account</h2></div>
<p class="muted small">This removes your account, your events, guest lists and uploads. Published event websites go offline immediately.</p>
<form class="form" method="post" style="margin-top:14px" data-confirm="Delete your account and all events? This can't be undone.">{csrf(req)}<input type="hidden" name="action" value="delete">
{field("confirm_email", "Type your email to confirm", "", type="email")}
<div><button class="btn btn--danger" type="submit">{i("trash")} Delete my account</button></div></form></section>
</div>"""
    return account_page(req, "Account", body, "/account")


@router.get("/account/export")
def export_data(req):
    user = auth.require_user(req)
    out = {"user": {k: user[k] for k in user.keys() if k != "password_hash"}, "events": [], "orders": []}
    for ev in db.q("SELECT * FROM events WHERE owner_id = ?", (user["id"],)):
        e = dict(ev)
        e["guests"] = [dict(g) for g in db.q("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))]
        e["functions"] = [dict(r) for r in db.q("SELECT * FROM event_functions WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))]
        e["schedule"] = [dict(r) for r in db.q("SELECT * FROM schedule_items WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))]
        e["tables"] = [dict(r) for r in db.q("SELECT * FROM seating_tables WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))]
        out["events"].append(e)
    out["orders"] = [dict(o) for o in db.q("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = ?", (user["id"],))]
    auth.audit(user["id"], "user.export", user["email"])
    return download(json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "aurelia-my-data.json", "application/json")
```
