```python
                   WHERE (e.owner_id = ? OR a.user_id = ?) AND e.status != 'archived'
                   ORDER BY CASE e.status WHEN 'draft' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, e.updated_at DESC""", (user["id"], user["id"]))
    first = (user["name"] or "").split(" ")[0]
    head = page_head(f"Welcome back, {first}" if rows else f"Welcome, {first}",
                     "Your events, drafts and RSVPs in one place.",
                     f'<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/create">{i("plus")}Create an event</a>')
    if not user["email_verified_at"]:
        head += (f'<div class="notice notice--warn" style="margin-bottom:18px">{i("mail")}<div>Please confirm your email address '
                 f'so RSVP updates and reports reach you. <a class="text-link" href="/account">Resend the email</a></div></div>')
    if not rows:
        body = head + (f'<div class="empty"><span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">{i("sparkle")}</span>'
                       f'<h2 style="font-size:1.375rem">Create your first event</h2>'
                       f'<p>Choose a category and template, add your details, and get one link for invitations, RSVPs, '
                       f'menus, seating and more. Your progress saves as you go.</p>'
                       f'<a class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" href="/create">Create your event</a></div>')
        return account_page(req, "My events", body, "/dashboard")
    cards = []
    for e in rows:
        ev = events.parse(e)
        s = events.stats(ev["id"])
        role = "" if ev["owner_id"] == user["id"] else '<span class="tag">Co-admin</span>'
        days = forms.days_until(ev.get("event_date"))
        when = forms.fmt_date(ev.get("event_date"), long=False) or "Date not set"
        if days is not None and days >= 0:
            when += f" · {days} day{'s' if days != 1 else ''} to go" if days else " · today"
        if ev["status"] == "draft":
            done = len(ev.get("wizard_done") or [])
            action = (f'<a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/setup/{ev["wizard_step"] or 1}">Continue setup</a>'
                      f'<span class="small muted">{done} of 10 steps done</span>')
            progress = f'<div class="progress"><span style="width:{done * 10}%"></span></div>'
        else:
            action = (f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}">Open dashboard</a>'
                      f'<a class="arrow-link" href="{events.public_path(ev)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>View website</span>{i("external")}</a>')
            progress = (f'<div class="bar-list__row"><span class="small muted">{s["attending"]} attending · {s["pending"]} to reply</span>'
                        f'<b class="mono small">{s["completion"]}%</b><div class="progress"><span style="width:{s["completion"]}%"></span></div></div>')
        cards.append(f"""<article class="box event-card"><div class="event-card__top"><div>
<h2 style="font-size:1.25rem"><a href="{base(ev)}" style="text-decoration:none">{esc(ev["name"])}</a></h2>
<div class="event-card__meta"><span>{esc(catalog.category_name(ev["category"]))}</span><span>{esc(when)}</span></div></div>
<div class="cluster">{role}{status_pill_event(ev)}</div></div>{progress}<div class="row">{action}</div></article>""")
    body = head + f'<div class="grid grid--2">{"".join(cards)}</div>'
    return account_page(req, "My events", body, "/dashboard")


def status_pill_event(ev) -> str:
    label = events.STATUS_LABELS.get(ev["status"], ev["status"])
    if ev["status"] == "draft" and not ev["paid_package"]:
        label = "Draft"
    return f'<span class="pill pill--{esc(ev["status"])}">{esc(label)}</span>'

@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>")
def overview(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    s = events.stats(ev["id"])
    days = forms.days_until(ev.get("event_date"))

    paid = catalog.package(ev["paid_package"])

    if not paid:
        banner = (f'<div class="cta-panel" style="margin-bottom:22px"><div><h2 style="font-size:1.6rem">Ready to share it?</h2>'

                  f'<div class="btn-row"><a class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" href="{base(ev)}/setup/10">Choose a package</a>'
                  f'<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{base(ev)}/setup/9">Preview</a></div></div>')

    kpis = f"""<div class="kpis" style="--n:5;margin-bottom:22px">

        ("Venue and directions", bool(venue.get("name")), f"{base(ev)}/setup/2"),
        ("Design chosen", 3 in (ev.get("wizard_done") or []), f"{base(ev)}/setup/3"),
        ("Package paid", bool(paid), f"{base(ev)}/setup/10"),

        f'<span{" class=muted" if ok else ""}>{esc(label)}</span></a>{"" if ok else i("arrow")}</li>' for label, ok, href in checklist)

    recent = db.q("""SELECT r.*, g.first_name, g.last_name, g.status FROM rsvp_responses r LEFT JOIN guests g ON g.id = r.guest_id

def _invite_message(ev) -> str:

    return (f"You're invited to {ev['name']}{when}. Everything you need, from directions to RSVP, "
            f"is on our event page: {events.public_url(ev)}")


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/share")

    sub_js = json.dumps("Invitation: " + ev["name"]).replace("<", "\\u003c")

@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/reports")
def reports_page(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if not has(ev, "basic_dashboard"):
        return organiser_page(req, ev, "Reports", page_head("Reports") + locked_panel(ev, "basic_dashboard", "Reports"), "/reports")
    can = has(ev, "reports")
    rows = []
    for kind, (title, desc) in reports.KINDS.items():
        links = (f'<a class="chip" href="{base(ev)}/reports/{kind}.pdf">{i("download")}PDF</a>'
                 f'<a class="chip" href="{base(ev)}/reports/{kind}.csv">{i("download")}CSV</a>') if can else f'<span class="tag">{i("lock")} Premium</span>'
        rows.append(f'<li><span><b>{esc(title)}</b><br><span class="small muted">{esc(desc)}</span></span><span class="row" style="flex-wrap:nowrap">{links}</span></li>')
    prefs = {"summary": "weekly", "new_rsvp": True, "auto_reminders": True, **(ev.get("report_prefs") or {})}
    summary_opts = [("none", "Don't send summaries"), ("daily", "Daily summary"), ("weekly", "Weekly summary (Mondays)")]
    final = ""
    if can:
        final = (f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/communications/final-report">{csrf(req)}<input type="hidden" name="back" value="/reports">'
                 f'<button class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" type="submit">{i("mail")}Email me the final report</button></form>')
    upsell = "" if can else (f'<div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:16px">{i("lock")}<div>Downloadable reports are part of the Premium Experience. '
                             f'Your RSVP numbers stay visible on the dashboard. <a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/setup/10">Compare packages</a></div></div>')
    reminders_switch = forms.switch("auto_reminders", "Remind guests who haven't replied, 7 and 2 days before the RSVP deadline",
                                    bool(prefs.get("auto_reminders"))) if has(ev, "reminders") else \
        '<p class="small muted">Automatic guest reminders are part of the Premium Experience.</p>'
    body = page_head("Reports", "Download what your venue, caterer and planner need, or have it emailed to you.", final) + upsell + f"""
<div class="cols cols--2"><div class="box"><ul class="list-plain list-rows">{"".join(rows)}</ul></div>
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/reports/prefs">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>Automatic emails</h2></div>
{forms.select("summary", "RSVP summaries to you", summary_opts, prefs.get("summary", "weekly"))}
{forms.switch("new_rsvp", "Email me every new RSVP", bool(prefs.get("new_rsvp")))}
{reminders_switch}
<p class="small muted">Event reminders reach you a week and a day before the event, and a post-event report follows the day after.</p>
<div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save preferences</button></div></form></div>"""
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Reports", body, "/reports")


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/reports/<kind>.<fmt>")
def report_download(req, uid, kind, fmt):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if kind not in reports.KINDS or fmt not in reports.FORMATS:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    if not has(ev, "reports"):
        raise HTTPError(403, "Downloadable reports are part of the Premium Experience.")
    name, data, ctype = reports.build(ev, kind, fmt, user_id=req.user["id"])
    return download(data, name, ctype)


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/reports/prefs")
def report_prefs(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    f = Form(req)
    summary = f.choice("summary", ["none", "daily", "weekly"], "summary", default="weekly")
    prefs = dict(ev.get("report_prefs") or {})
    prefs.update({"summary": summary, "new_rsvp": f.flag("new_rsvp")})
    if has(ev, "reminders"):
        prefs["auto_reminders"] = f.flag("auto_reminders")
    events.save_json(ev["id"], "report_prefs", prefs)
    return go(req, ev, "/reports", "success", "Email preferences saved.")

# Settings
# =============================================================================================
@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings")
def settings(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    vis = {**events.default_sections(), **(ev.get("sections") or {})}
    toggles = []
    for key, label, feature in events.SECTION_KEYS:
        allowed = feature is None or has(ev, feature)
        extra = {} if allowed else {"disabled": True}
        lock = "" if allowed else f' <span class="tag">{i("lock")} not in package</span>'
        toggles.append(f'<label class="switch"><input type="checkbox" name="sections" value="{key}"'
                       f'{" checked" if vis.get(key) and allowed else ""}{" disabled" if extra else ""}><span>{esc(label)}{lock}</span></label>')
    owner = ev["owner_id"] == req.user["id"]
    live = events.is_live(ev)
    if not ev["paid_package"]:
        pub = (f'<p class="small muted">Publishing needs a confirmed payment.</p>'
               f'<a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/setup/10">Choose a package</a>')
    elif ev["status"] == "suspended":
        pub = '<p class="small">This event is suspended by the platform. <a class="text-link" href="/contact">Contact support</a>.</p>'
    elif live:
        pub = (f'<p class="small muted">Your website is live. Unpublishing hides it from guests straight away; you can publish it again any time.</p>'
               f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/unpublish" data-confirm="Hide the website from guests?">{csrf(req)}'
               f'<button class="btn btn--danger btn--sm" type="submit">Unpublish website</button></form>')
    else:
        pub = (f'<p class="small muted">Your website is hidden from guests.</p><form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/publish">{csrf(req)}'
               f'<button class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" type="submit">Publish website</button></form>')
    hosting = f'<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:8px">Hosted until {esc(forms.fmt_date(ev["hosting_until"]))}.</p>' if ev.get("hosting_until") else ""

    admins_box = ""
    if has(ev, "co_admins"):
        admins = db.q("SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email FROM event_admins a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
        limit = catalog.limit(ev, "admins", 1)
        lis = "".join(
            f'<li><span><b>{esc(a["name"])}</b><br><span class="small muted">{esc(a["email"])}</span></span>'
            + (f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/admins/{a["id"]}/remove" data-confirm="Remove {esc(a["name"])}?">{csrf(req)}'
               f'<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" type="submit">Remove</button></form>' if owner else "") + "</li>" for a in admins)
        add = ""
        if owner and 1 + len(admins) < limit:
            add = (f'<form class="row" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/admins" style="margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:nowrap">{csrf(req)}'
                   f'<input class="input input--sm" type="email" name="email" placeholder="their@email.com" required aria-label="Administrator email">'
                   f'<button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Add</button></form>'
                   f'<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:6px">They need an {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)} account with this email.</p>')
        admins_box = (f'<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Administrators</h2><span class="small muted">{1 + len(admins)} of {limit}</span></div>'
                      f'<ul class="list-plain list-rows"><li><span><b>Owner</b></span><span class="tag">Full access</span></li>{lis}</ul>{add}</div>')
    else:
        admins_box = (f'<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Administrators</h2></div><p class="small muted">Add co-hosts or planners with the Signature Experience.</p></div>')

    danger = ""
    if owner:
        danger = f"""<div class="box" style="border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--error) 30%,transparent)"><div class="box__head"><h2>Delete event</h2></div>
<p class="small muted">This permanently removes the website, guests, RSVPs, seating and uploads. Payments and receipts stay on record. It can’t be undone.</p>
<form class="form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/delete" style="margin-top:12px">{csrf(req)}
{forms.field("confirm_name", f"Type “{ev['name']}” to confirm", "", attrs={"autocomplete": "off"})}
<div><button class="btn btn--danger btn--sm" type="submit">Delete permanently</button></div></form></div>"""
    body = page_head("Settings", "Control what guests see and who can manage this event.") + f"""
<div class="cols cols--even"><div class="stack">
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/sections">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>Website sections</h2></div>
<p class="small muted">Switch off anything you don’t want public. Guest lists are never shown publicly.</p>
<div style="display:grid;gap:2px">{"".join(toggles)}</div><div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save sections</button></div></form>
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/slug">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>Website address</h2></div>
<div class="field"><label for="f-slug">{esc(config.BASE_URL)}/events/</label><input class="input mono" id="f-slug" name="slug" value="{esc(ev["slug"])}" maxlength="60" pattern="[a-z0-9-]+" required></div>
<p class="small muted">Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it breaks links you’ve already shared.{" Custom domains are available on request for Signature events." if has(ev, "custom_domain") else ""}</p>
<div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save address</button></div></form></div>
<div class="stack"><div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Publishing</h2>{status_pill_event(ev)}</div>{pub}{hosting}</div>
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/rsvp">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>RSVPs</h2></div>
{forms.switch("rsvp_open", "Accept RSVPs", bool(ev["rsvp_open"]))}<p class="small muted">Close RSVPs once your numbers are final; guests will see a short note instead of the form.</p>
<div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save</button></div></form>
{admins_box}{danger}</div></div>"""
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Settings", body, "/settings")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/sections")
def settings_sections(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    chosen = set(req.getlist("sections"))
    current = {**events.default_sections(), **(ev.get("sections") or {})}
    for key, _, feature in events.SECTION_KEYS:
        if feature is None or has(ev, feature):
            current[key] = key in chosen
    events.save_json(ev["id"], "sections", current)
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "Website sections saved.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/slug")
def settings_slug(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    slug = req.get("slug").lower()
    if not forms.SLUG_RE.match(slug) or slug in events.RESERVED_SLUGS:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "Use 3 to 60 lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.")
    if slug == ev["slug"]:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "info", "That’s already your address.")
    if db.one("SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?", (slug, ev["id"])):
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", f"/events/{slug} is taken. Try adding your date or a word.")
    events.touch(ev["id"], slug=slug)
    auth.audit(req.user["id"], "event.slug", ev["uid"], old=ev["slug"], new=slug)
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", f"Your website is now at /events/{slug}.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/rsvp")
def settings_rsvp(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    open_ = req.get("rsvp_open") == "1"
    events.touch(ev["id"], rsvp_open=1 if open_ else 0)
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "RSVPs are open." if open_ else "RSVPs are closed.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/publish")
def settings_publish(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    ok, msg = notify.publish(ev, req.user["id"])
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success" if ok else "error", msg)


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/unpublish")
def settings_unpublish(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["status"] != "published":
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "info", "The website isn’t published.")
    notify.unpublish(ev, req.user["id"])
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "Your website is now hidden from guests.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/admins")
def settings_admin_add(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can change administrators.")
    if not has(ev, "co_admins"):
        raise HTTPError(403, "Additional administrators are part of the Signature Experience.")
    email = req.get("email").lower()
    count = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_admins WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],), 0)
    if 1 + count >= catalog.limit(ev, "admins", 1):
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "You’ve reached your package’s administrator limit.")
    user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)) if forms.EMAIL_RE.match(email or "") else None
    if user is None:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "No account uses that email yet. Ask them to register first, then add them.")
    if user["id"] == ev["owner_id"]:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "info", "That’s you, the owner.")
    db.run("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO event_admins (event_id, user_id, role, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor', ?)",
           (ev["id"], user["id"], db.now()))
    from ..services import email as mail
    mail.send(user["email"], "co_admin_invite", {**notify.event_vars(ev), "inviter": req.user["name"]},
              event_id=ev["id"], user_id=user["id"])
    auth.audit(req.user["id"], "event.admin_add", ev["uid"], user=user["email"])
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", f"{user['name']} can now manage this event.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/admins/<int:user_id>/remove")
def settings_admin_remove(req, uid, user_id):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can change administrators.")
    db.run("DELETE FROM event_admins WHERE event_id = ? AND user_id = ?", (ev["id"], user_id))
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "Administrator removed.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/delete")
def settings_delete(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can delete it.")
    if req.get("confirm_name").strip() != ev["name"].strip():
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "Type the event name exactly to delete it.")
    for up in events.uploads(ev["id"]):
        storage.delete(up["storage_key"])
    paid_orders = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE event_id = ? AND status = 'paid'", (ev["id"],), 0)
    if paid_orders:
        # Keep financial records: archive instead of hard-deleting, but wipe guest data (POPIA).
        with db.transaction():
            db.run("DELETE FROM guests WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
            db.run("DELETE FROM seating_tables WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
            db.run("DELETE FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
            db.run("UPDATE events SET status = 'archived', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (db.now(), ev["id"]))
    else:
        db.run("DELETE FROM events WHERE id = ?", (ev["id"],))
    auth.audit(req.user["id"], "event.delete", ev["uid"], name=ev["name"])
    req.flash("success", f"{ev['name']} was deleted.")
    return redirect("/dashboard")
```

<!-- FILE: app/views/forms.py sha256=cd76634c90cfd1880e1ee281e1b97513368a63444255b8d6363f8ae819427558 nl=1 -->
```python
"""Form rendering helpers and server-side validation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any, Iterable, Optional

from ..web import esc

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]{1,64}@[^@\s]{1,190}\.[A-Za-z]{2,24}$")
PHONE_RE = re.compile(r"^\+?[0-9 ()-]{7,20}$")
TIME_RE = re.compile(r"^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$")
HEX_RE = re.compile(r"^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$")
SLUG_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{1,58}[a-z0-9])?$")


class Form:
    """Collects cleaned values and errors. `f.text('name', required=True, max=120)` etc."""

    def __init__(self, req):
        self.req = req
        self.data: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.errors: dict[str, str] = {}

    def _raw(self, name: str) -> str:
        return self.req.get(name)

    def text(self, name: str, label: str = "", required: bool = False, max: int = 500, min: int = 0) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        label = label or name.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and len(v) > max:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be {max} characters or fewer."
        elif v and len(v) < min:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be at least {min} characters."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def email(self, name: str, label: str = "Email", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name).lower()
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and not EMAIL_RE.match(v):
            self.errors[name] = "Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def phone(self, name: str, label: str = "Phone", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and not PHONE_RE.match(v):
            self.errors[name] = "Enter a phone number using digits, spaces and an optional +."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def integer(self, name: str, label: str = "", required: bool = False, min: int = 0, max: int = 100000,
                default: int = 0) -> int:
        raw = self._raw(name)
        label = label or name.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
        if not raw:
            if required:
                self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
            self.data[name] = default
            return default
        try:
            v = int(raw)
        except ValueError:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a whole number."
            self.data[name] = default
            return default
        if v < min or v > max:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be between {min} and {max}."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def date(self, name: str, label: str = "Date", required: bool = False, future: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v:
            try:
                d = date.fromisoformat(v)
                if future and d < date.today():
                    self.errors[name] = f"{label} can't be in the past."
            except ValueError:
                self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a valid date."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def time(self, name: str, label: str = "Time", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and not TIME_RE.match(v):
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a time like 14:30."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def url(self, name: str, label: str = "Link", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if v and not re.match(r"^https?://", v, re.I):
            v = "https://" + v
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and (len(v) > 600 or not re.match(r"^https?://[^\s<>\"]+\.[^\s<>\"]+", v, re.I)):
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a web address."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def color(self, name: str, default: str) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if not HEX_RE.match(v or ""):
            v = default
        self.data[name] = v.upper()
        return v.upper()

    def choice(self, name: str, options: Iterable[str], label: str = "", required: bool = False, default: str = "") -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        opts = list(options)
        if v and v not in opts:
            self.errors[name] = f"Choose one of the listed {label.lower() or 'options'}."
            v = default
        elif required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label or 'This'} is required."
        self.data[name] = v or default
        return v or default

    def flag(self, name: str) -> bool:
        v = self.req.get(name) in ("1", "on", "true", "yes")
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def error(self, name: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.errors[name] = message

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return not self.errors


# --- rendering -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def csrf(req) -> str:
    return f'<input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{esc(req.csrf)}">'


def honeypot() -> str:
    return ('<div class="hp" aria-hidden="true"><label>Leave this empty <input name="website" tabindex="-1" '
            'autocomplete="off"></label></div>')


def errors_summary(errors: dict) -> str:
    if not errors:
        return ""
    items = "".join(f"<li>{esc(m)}</li>" for m in errors.values())
    return (f'<div class="form-errors" role="alert" tabindex="-1" data-focus><b>Please fix '
            f'{"this" if len(errors) == 1 else "these " + str(len(errors))} '
            f'{"item" if len(errors) == 1 else "items"}:</b><ul>{items}</ul></div>')


def _attrs(attrs: Optional[dict]) -> str:
    if not attrs:
        return ""
    out = []
    for k, v in attrs.items():
        if v is True:
            out.append(f" {k}")
        elif v not in (False, None):
            out.append(f' {k}="{esc(v)}"')
    return "".join(out)


def field(name: str, label: str, value: Any = "", type: str = "text", required: bool = False, hint: str = "",
          errors: Optional[dict] = None, attrs: Optional[dict] = None, wrap_class: str = "") -> str:
    err = (errors or {}).get(name)
    fid = "f-" + name.replace("_", "-")
    described = f' aria-describedby="{fid}-hint"' if hint else ""
    if err:
        described = f' aria-describedby="{fid}-err"' + (f' aria-errormessage="{fid}-err"' if True else "")
    a = _attrs(attrs)
    req_attr = " required" if required else ""
    inv = ' aria-invalid="true"' if err else ""
    if type == "textarea":
        control = (f'<textarea class="textarea" id="{fid}" name="{esc(name)}"{req_attr}{inv}{described}{a}>'
                   f'{esc(value)}</textarea>')
    else:
        control = (f'<input class="input" id="{fid}" name="{esc(name)}" type="{type}" value="{esc(value)}"'
                   f'{req_attr}{inv}{described}{a}>')
    req_mark = ' <span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span>' if required else ""
    hint_html = f'<span class="hint" id="{fid}-hint">{hint}</span>' if hint else ""
    err_html = f'<span class="field-error" id="{fid}-err">{esc(err)}</span>' if err else ""
    cls = "field" + (" has-error" if err else "") + (f" {wrap_class}" if wrap_class else "")
    return f'<div class="{cls}"><label for="{fid}">{esc(label)}{req_mark}</label>{control}{hint_html}{err_html}</div>'


def select(name: str, label: str, options: Iterable, value: Any = "", required: bool = False, hint: str = "",
           errors: Optional[dict] = None, blank: str = "", attrs: Optional[dict] = None) -> str:
    err = (errors or {}).get(name)
    fid = "f-" + name.replace("_", "-")
    opts = [f'<option value="">{esc(blank)}</option>'] if blank else []
    for o in options:
        v, t = (o if isinstance(o, (tuple, list)) else (o, o))[:2]
        sel = " selected" if str(v) == str(value) else ""
        opts.append(f'<option value="{esc(v)}"{sel}>{esc(t)}</option>')
    req_mark = ' <span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span>' if required else ""
    hint_html = f'<span class="hint">{hint}</span>' if hint else ""
    err_html = f'<span class="field-error">{esc(err)}</span>' if err else ""
    return (f'<div class="field{" has-error" if err else ""}"><label for="{fid}">{esc(label)}{req_mark}</label>'
            f'<select class="select" id="{fid}" name="{esc(name)}"{" required" if required else ""}{_attrs(attrs)}>'
            f'{"".join(opts)}</select>{hint_html}{err_html}</div>')


def check(name: str, label: str, checked: bool = False, value: str = "1", hint: str = "", attrs: Optional[dict] = None,
          type: str = "checkbox") -> str:
    c = " checked" if checked else ""
    hint_html = f'<span class="hint" style="display:block">{hint}</span>' if hint else ""
    return (f'<label class="check"><input type="{type}" name="{esc(name)}" value="{esc(value)}"{c}{_attrs(attrs)}>'
            f'<span>{label}{hint_html}</span></label>')


def switch(name: str, label: str, checked: bool = False, attrs: Optional[dict] = None) -> str:
    c = " checked" if checked else ""
    return (f'<label class="switch"><input type="checkbox" name="{esc(name)}" value="1"{c}{_attrs(attrs)}>'
            f'<span>{esc(label)}</span></label>')


def color(name: str, label: str, value: str) -> str:
    fid = "f-" + name
    return (f'<div class="field"><label for="{fid}">{esc(label)}</label><div class="color-field">'
            f'<input type="color" id="{fid}" value="{esc(value)}" data-sync="{esc(name)}" aria-label="{esc(label)}">'
            f'<input type="text" name="{esc(name)}" value="{esc(value)}" maxlength="7" pattern="#[0-9A-Fa-f]{{6}}" '
            f'aria-label="{esc(label)} hex value"></div></div>')


def fmt_date(iso: Optional[str], long: bool = True) -> str:
    if not iso:
        return ""
    try:
        d = date.fromisoformat(iso[:10])
    except ValueError:
        return iso
    return d.strftime("%A, %-d %B %Y") if long else d.strftime("%-d %b %Y")


def fmt_time(hhmm: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not hhmm:
        return ""
    try:
        t = datetime.strptime(hhmm, "%H:%M")
    except ValueError:
        return hhmm
    return t.strftime("%H:%M")


def fmt_dt(iso: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """UTC ISO timestamp → '16 Nov 2026, 14:05' in SAST (UTC+2, no DST)."""
    if not iso:
        return ""
    try:
        from datetime import timedelta
        d = datetime.fromisoformat(iso) + timedelta(hours=2)
        return d.strftime("%-d %b %Y, %H:%M")
    except ValueError:
        return iso


def days_until(iso: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if not iso:
        return None
    try:
        return (date.fromisoformat(iso[:10]) - date.today()).days
    except ValueError:
        return None


def slugify(text: str, max_len: int = 60) -> str:
    text = text.lower().replace("&", " and ")
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")
    return text[:max_len].strip("-") or "event"
```

```python
"""Page shells: the marketing site (header, drawer, footer), the app shell (dashboard and admin),
toasts, and the error page."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from .. import config
from ..icons import i
from ..web import esc

FONTS = ("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@300..700&family=Geist+Mono:wght@400..600"
         "&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap")

THEME_SCRIPT = """<script>(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem('aurelia-theme-v1');
if(t==='dark'||t==='light'){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);}}catch(e){}
document.documentElement.classList.add('js');})();</script>"""

BRAND_MARK = """<svg class="brand__mark" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true"><defs><linearGradient id="bm" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
<stop offset="0" stop-color="#9F87E6"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#E58DB3"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#F0A77E"/></linearGradient></defs>
<circle cx="12" cy="16" r="8.2" fill="none" stroke="url(#bm)" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="20" cy="16" r="8.2" fill="none" stroke="url(#bm)" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="16" cy="16" r="1.8" fill="#8B73D8"/></svg>"""

NAV = [
    ("Weddings", "/weddings"),
    ("Baby", "/baby-celebrations"),
    ("Parties", "/parties"),
    ("Other events", "/celebrations"),
    ("Templates", "/templates"),
    ("Pricing", "/pricing"),
    ("How it works", "/how-it-works"),
]


def brand(href: str = "/") -> str:
    return f'<a class="brand" href="{href}" aria-label="{esc(config.BRAND_NAME)} home">{BRAND_MARK}<span class="brand__name">{esc(config.BRAND_NAME)}</span></a>'


def head(title: str, description: str = "", extra: str = "", noindex: bool = False) -> str:
    full = title if config.BRAND_NAME in title else f"{title} · {config.BRAND_NAME}"
    desc = description or config.BRAND_TAGLINE
    robots = '<meta name="robots" content="noindex">' if noindex else ""
    return f"""<!doctype html><html lang="en-ZA" data-theme="light"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>{esc(full)}</title>
<meta name="description" content="{esc(desc)}">{robots}
<meta property="og:title" content="{esc(full)}"><meta property="og:description" content="{esc(desc)}">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#F8F6FC">
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{FONTS}">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/app.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/icons.css">
{THEME_SCRIPT}{extra}</head>"""


def toasts(req) -> str:
    items = req.take_flashes() if hasattr(req, "take_flashes") else []
    if not items:
        return '<div class="toasts" aria-live="polite"></div>'
    icon = {"success": "check", "error": "alert", "info": "info"}
    html = "".join(
        f'<div class="toast toast--{esc(k)} glass glass--strong" role="status">{i(icon.get(k, "info"))}'
        f'<span>{esc(m)}</span><button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" data-dismiss>×</button></div>'
        for k, m in items)
    return f'<div class="toasts" aria-live="polite">{html}</div>'


def theme_toggle() -> str:
    return (f'<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon theme-toggle" type="button" data-theme-toggle '
            f'aria-label="Switch light or dark theme">{i("sun", "i--sun")}{i("moon", "i--moon")}</button>')


def header(req, current: str = "") -> str:
    links = "".join(
        f'<li><a href="{href}"{" aria-current=page" if current == href else ""}>{esc(label)}</a></li>'
        for label, href in NAV)
    drawer_links = "".join(
        f'<a href="{href}"{" aria-current=page" if current == href else ""}>{esc(label)}</a>' for label, href in NAV)
    if req.user:
        account = (f'<a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="/dashboard">My events</a>')
        cta = '<a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="/create">Create your event</a>'
        drawer_acc = '<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="/dashboard">My events</a>'
    else:
        account = '<a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="/login">Log in</a>'
        cta = '<a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="/create">Create your event</a>'
        drawer_acc = '<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="/login">Log in</a>'
    return f"""<a class="btn btn--primary skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a>
<header class="site-header" data-header><div class="site-header__bar">{brand()}
<nav class="nav" aria-label="Main"><ul>{links}</ul></nav>
<div class="header-actions">{theme_toggle()}<span class="hide-sm">{account}</span>{cta}
<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon menu-btn" type="button" data-drawer-open aria-label="Open menu" aria-controls="drawer">{i("menu")}</button></div></div></header>
<dialog class="drawer" id="drawer" aria-label="Menu"><div class="drawer__head">{brand()}<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon" type="button" data-drawer-close aria-label="Close menu" style="color:inherit">{i("close")}</button></div>
<nav aria-label="Mobile">{drawer_links}</nav><div class="drawer__foot on-dark"><a class="btn btn--primary" href="/create">Create your event</a>{drawer_acc}</div></dialog>"""


def footer() -> str:
    year = __import__("datetime").date.today().year
    social = "".join(
        f'<a href="{href}" aria-label="{label} (link to be confirmed)">{i(icon)}</a>'
        for label, href, icon in [("Instagram", "#", "image"), ("Facebook", "#", "users"), ("WhatsApp", "#", "chat")])
    return f"""<footer class="site-footer on-dark"><div class="container">
<div class="footer-grid"><div class="stack" style="--stack:14px">{brand()}<p class="muted" style="max-width:38ch">{esc(config.BRAND_TAGLINE)} {esc(config.BRAND_LINE)}</p>
<p class="small muted">{esc(config.COMPANY_ADDRESS)}<br><a class="text-link" href="mailto:{esc(config.SUPPORT_EMAIL)}">{esc(config.SUPPORT_EMAIL)}</a></p></div>
<div><h3>Events</h3><ul><li><a href="/weddings">Weddings</a></li><li><a href="/baby-celebrations">Baby celebrations</a></li><li><a href="/parties">Parties</a></li><li><a href="/celebrations">Other events</a></li></ul></div>
<div><h3>Platform</h3><ul><li><a href="/templates">Templates</a></li><li><a href="/pricing">Pricing</a></li><li><a href="/how-it-works">How it works</a></li><li><a href="/faq">FAQ</a></li></ul></div>
<div><h3>Company</h3><ul><li><a href="/contact">Contact &amp; support</a></li><li><a href="/privacy">Privacy (POPIA)</a></li><li><a href="/terms">Terms of service</a></li><li><a href="/refunds">Refund policy</a></li></ul></div></div>
<div class="footer-bottom"><span>© {year} {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)}. Prices in South African Rand, VAT inclusive.</span><div class="socials">{social}</div></div>
<div class="wordmark-giant" aria-hidden="true"><span>A</span>urelia</div></div></footer>"""


def page(req, title: str, body: str, current: str = "", description: str = "", body_class: str = "site",
         noindex: bool = False, extra_head: str = "") -> str:
    return (head(title, description, extra_head, noindex) +
            f'<body class="{body_class}"><meta name="csrf" content="{esc(req.csrf)}">' + header(req, current) +
            f'<main id="main">{body}</main>' + footer() + toasts(req) +
            '<script src="/static/js/app.js" defer></script></body></html>')


def bare(req, title: str, body: str, noindex: bool = True, body_class: str = "site", extra_head: str = "") -> str:
    """Header without footer (auth pages)."""
    return (head(title, "", extra_head, noindex) + f'<body class="{body_class}"><meta name="csrf" content="{esc(req.csrf)}">'
            + header(req) + f'<main id="main">{body}</main>' + toasts(req)
            + '<script src="/static/js/app.js" defer></script></body></html>')


# --- app shell ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def app_shell(req, title: str, body: str, nav_html: str, current_event=None, extra_head: str = "",
              extra_scripts: str = "") -> str:
    user = req.user
    initials = "".join(p[0] for p in (user["name"] or "?").split()[:2]).upper() if user else ""
    return (head(title, "", extra_head, True) +
            f'<body class="app-body"><meta name="csrf" content="{esc(req.csrf)}">'
            f'<a class="btn btn--primary skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a><div class="app">'
            f'<aside class="sidebar" aria-label="App">{brand("/dashboard")}{nav_html}'
            f'<div class="sidebar__foot"><div class="row" style="gap:10px;padding:6px 8px">'
            f'<span class="icon-tile" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600">{esc(initials)}</span>'
            f'<span class="small" style="line-height:1.3"><b>{esc(user["name"] if user else "")}</b><br><span class="muted tiny">{esc(user["email"] if user else "")}</span></span></div>'
            f'<form method="post" action="/logout">{_csrf(req)}<button class="side-link" style="width:100%;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer" type="submit">{i("logout")}Log out</button></form></div></aside>'
            f'<div class="app-main"><header class="topbar">{brand("/dashboard")}<div class="topbar__actions">'
            f'{theme_toggle()}<a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="/" >View site</a>'
            f'<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon menu-btn-app" type="button" data-drawer-open aria-controls="drawer" aria-label="Open menu" style="display:var(--show-menu,inline-flex)">{i("menu")}</button></div></header>'
            f'<dialog class="drawer" id="drawer" aria-label="Menu"><div class="drawer__head">{brand("/dashboard")}'
            f'<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon" type="button" data-drawer-close aria-label="Close menu" style="color:inherit">{i("close")}</button></div>'
            f'<div class="app-drawer-nav on-dark" style="padding:12px">{nav_html}'
            f'<form method="post" action="/logout" style="margin-top:12px">{_csrf(req)}<button class="btn btn--secondary btn--block" type="submit">Log out</button></form></div></dialog>'
            f'<main id="main" class="app-content">{body}</main></div></div>{toasts(req)}'
            f'<style>@media (min-width:1024px){{.menu-btn-app{{display:none!important}}}}</style>'
            f'<script src="/static/js/app.js" defer></script>{extra_scripts}</body></html>')


def _csrf(req) -> str:
    return f'<input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{esc(req.csrf)}">'


def side_link(href: str, label: str, icon: str, current: str, locked: bool = False) -> str:
    cur = ' aria-current="page"' if current == href else ""
    lock = i("lock", "lock") if locked else ""
    return f'<a class="side-link" href="{href}"{cur}>{i(icon)}<span>{esc(label)}</span>{lock}</a>'


def error_page(req, status: int, message: str) -> str:
    titles = {403: "Not allowed", 404: "Page not found", 405: "Not allowed", 500: "Something went wrong"}
    title = titles.get(status, "Error")
    body = f"""<section class="page-hero" style="min-height:70vh;display:grid;align-content:center"><div class="grid-texture"></div>
<div class="container"><p class="mono muted">Error {status}</p><h1 style="margin-top:10px">{esc(title)}</h1>
<p class="lead">{esc(message if status != 404 else "The page you were looking for isn't here. It may have moved, or the link may be private.")}</p>
<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:28px"><a class="btn btn--primary" href="/">Go to the home page</a><a class="btn btn--secondary" href="/contact">Contact support</a></div></div></section>"""
    return page(req, title, body, noindex=True)
```

```python
"""Organiser tools: guests (with CSV import), RSVPs, seating editor, menu, programme, communications."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import json
import re
import secrets
from urllib.parse import quote

from .. import auth, catalog, db, events, notify
from ..icons import i
from ..services import email as mail
from ..web import HTTPError, Response, download, esc, json_response, redirect, router, url
from . import forms
from .forms import Form, csrf
from .shell import locked_panel, organiser_page, page_head

MEAL_PILL = ' <span class="pill pill--gold pill--plain">Meal option</span>'
BR_MUTED = '<br><span class="small muted">'
BR_SMALL = '<br><span class="small">'
COURSES = ["Canapés", "Starter", "Main", "Dessert", "Drinks", "Late-night", "Other"]
KINDS = [("ceremony", "Ceremony"), ("reception", "Reception"), ("speech", "Speech"), ("entertainment", "Entertainment"),
         ("activity", "Activity"), ("meal", "Meal"), ("other", "Other")]
STATUS_LABEL = {"attending": "Attending", "declined": "Declined", "pending": "Pending"}
DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = ["Family", "Friends", "Colleagues"]


# --- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load(req, uid: str) -> dict:
    return events.parse(auth.event_for(req, uid))


def base(ev) -> str:
    return f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}"


def has(ev, feature: str) -> bool:
    return catalog.has_feature(ev, feature)


def go(req, ev, suffix: str, kind: str = "", msg: str = ""):
    if msg:
        req.flash(kind or "success", msg)
    return redirect(base(ev) + suffix)


def _guest(ev, gid: int):
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE id = ? AND event_id = ?", (gid, ev["id"]))
    if g is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return g


def status_pill(status: str) -> str:
    return f'<span class="pill pill--{esc(status)}">{esc(STATUS_LABEL.get(status, status))}</span>'


def wa_digits(phone: str) -> str:
    d = re.sub(r"\D", "", phone or "")
    if d.startswith("0") and len(d) == 10:
        d = "27" + d[1:]
    return d


def guest_whatsapp(ev, g) -> str:
    msg = (f"Hi {g['first_name']}, you're invited to {ev['name']}. "
           f"Your personal invitation and RSVP link: {events.invite_url(ev, g)}")
    d = wa_digits(g["phone"])
    return f"https://wa.me/{d}?text={quote(msg)}" if d else f"https://wa.me/?text={quote(msg)}"


def categories_for(ev) -> list:
    gs = ev.get("guest_settings") or {}
    cats = [c for c in (gs.get("categories") or []) if c]
    if not has(ev, "guest_categories"):
        return DEFAULT_CATEGORIES
    return list(dict.fromkeys(cats + DEFAULT_CATEGORIES + ["VIP"]))


def tabs(ev, current: str, items: list) -> str:
    links = "".join(f'<a href="{base(ev)}{s}"{" aria-current=page" if s == current else ""}>{esc(l)}</a>' for s, l in items)
    return f'<nav class="tabs" aria-label="Section">{links}</nav>'


# =============================================================================================
# Guests
# =============================================================================================
@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests")
def guests_list(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if not has(ev, "basic_dashboard"):
        return organiser_page(req, ev, "Guests", page_head("Guests") + locked_panel(ev, "basic_dashboard", "The guest dashboard"), "/guests")
    can_edit = has(ev, "guest_management")
    personal = has(ev, "personal_invites")
    st, cat, grp, qtext = req.arg("status"), req.arg("category"), req.arg("group"), req.arg("q").strip()
    sql = """SELECT g.*, t.name AS table_name FROM guests g
             LEFT JOIN seat_assignments a ON a.guest_id = g.id LEFT JOIN seating_tables t ON t.id = a.table_id
             WHERE g.event_id = ?"""
    params: list = [ev["id"]]
    if st in STATUS_LABEL:
        sql += " AND g.status = ?"
        params.append(st)
    if cat:
        sql += " AND g.category = ?"
        params.append(cat)
    if grp:
        sql += " AND g.family_group = ?"
        params.append(grp)
    if qtext:
        sql += " AND (g.first_name || ' ' || g.last_name LIKE ? OR g.email LIKE ? OR g.phone LIKE ?)"
        like = f"%{qtext}%"
        params += [like, like, like]
    sql += " ORDER BY g.last_name COLLATE NOCASE, g.first_name COLLATE NOCASE"
    rows = db.q(sql, params)
    s = events.stats(ev["id"])
    all_cats = [r[0] for r in db.q("SELECT DISTINCT category FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND category != '' ORDER BY 1", (ev["id"],))]
    all_groups = [r[0] for r in db.q("SELECT DISTINCT family_group FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND family_group != '' ORDER BY 1", (ev["id"],))]

    actions = ""
    if can_edit:
        actions = (f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/guests/import">{i("upload")}Import CSV</a>'
                   f'<a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/guests/new">{i("plus")}Add guest</a>')
    head = page_head("Guests", f"{s['invited']} on the list · {s['headcount']} people attending including plus-ones and children.", actions)
    notice = ""
    if not can_edit:
        notice = ('<div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:16px">' + i("info") + '<div>Guests who RSVP through your '
                  'event link appear here. Adding, importing and editing guests is part of the Premium Experience. '
                  f'<a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/setup/10">Compare packages</a></div></div>')

    def opts(values, current, blank):
        return f'<option value="">{blank}</option>' + "".join(
            f'<option value="{esc(v)}"{" selected" if v == current else ""}>{esc(v)}</option>' for v in values)

    status_opts = opts(list(STATUS_LABEL), st, "All statuses").replace(">attending<", ">Attending<").replace(">declined<", ">Declined<").replace(">pending<", ">Pending<")
    toolbar = (f'<form class="toolbar" method="get" role="search">'
               f'<input class="input grow" type="search" name="q" value="{esc(qtext)}" placeholder="Search name, email or phone" aria-label="Search guests">'
               f'<select class="select" name="status" data-autosubmit aria-label="Status">{status_opts}</select>'
               + (f'<select class="select" name="category" data-autosubmit aria-label="Category">{opts(all_cats, cat, "All categories")}</select>' if all_cats else "")
               + (f'<select class="select" name="group" data-autosubmit aria-label="Family group">{opts(all_groups, grp, "All groups")}</select>' if all_groups else "")
               + '<button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Filter</button>'
               + (f'<a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/guests">Clear</a>' if (st or cat or grp or qtext) else "")
               + "</form>")
    if not rows:
        if st or cat or grp or qtext:
            body = '<div class="empty"><p>No guests match these filters.</p></div>'
        else:
            cta = (f'<div class="btn-row"><a class="btn btn--primary" href="{base(ev)}/guests/new">Add your first guest</a>'
                   f'<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{base(ev)}/guests/import">Import a CSV</a></div>') if can_edit else \
                  f'<a class="btn btn--primary" href="{base(ev)}/share">Share your event link</a>'
            body = (f'<div class="empty"><span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">{i("users")}</span>'
                    f'<h2 style="font-size:1.25rem">No guests yet</h2><p>Add guests one by one, import a spreadsheet, '
                    f'or let guests RSVP through your shared link.</p>{cta}</div>')
    else:
        trs = []
        for g in rows:
            party = events.party_size(g)
            sub = " · ".join(x for x in (g["email"], g["phone"]) if x)
            tags = "".join(f'<span class="tag">{esc(t)}</span> ' for t in (g["category"], g["family_group"], g["side"]) if t)
            if g["is_vip"]:
                tags += '<span class="pill pill--gold pill--plain">VIP</span> '
            if g["unsubscribed_at"]:
                tags += '<span class="tag" title="Asked not to receive event emails">No emails</span>'
            row_actions = []
            if can_edit:
                row_actions.append(f'<a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/guests/{g["id"]}" aria-label="Edit {esc(events.guest_name(g))}">{i("edit")}</a>')
            if personal:
                row_actions.append(f'<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" type="button" data-copy="{esc(events.invite_url(ev, g))}" data-copied="Personal link copied" aria-label="Copy personal link">{i("link")}</button>')
                row_actions.append(f'<a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="{esc(guest_whatsapp(ev, g))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Send on WhatsApp">{i("chat")}</a>')
            if can_edit:
                label = "Undo check-in" if g["checked_in_at"] else "Check in"
                row_actions.append(f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/guests/{g["id"]}/checkin" style="display:inline">{csrf(req)}'
                                   f'<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" type="submit" title="{label}" aria-label="{label}">'
                                   f'{i("check") if not g["checked_in_at"] else i("close")}</button></form>')
            checked = f'<span class="pill pill--ok pill--plain" title="Checked in">Here</span>' if g["checked_in_at"] else ""
            box = (f'<td><input type="checkbox" name="ids" value="{g["id"]}" form="bulk" aria-label="Select {esc(events.guest_name(g))}"></td>'
                   if can_edit else "")
            trs.append(f'<tr>{box}<td><b>{esc(events.guest_name(g))}</b> {checked}<span class="table__sub">{esc(sub)}</span></td>'
                       f'<td>{tags or "<span class=muted>—</span>"}</td><td>{status_pill(g["status"])}</td>'
                       f'<td class="num mono">{party if g["status"] != "declined" else "—"}</td>'
                       f'<td>{esc(g["table_name"] or "")}</td><td style="white-space:nowrap;text-align:right">{"".join(row_actions)}</td></tr>')
        head_box = '<th><span class="sr-only">Select</span></th>' if can_edit else ""
        body = (f'<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr>{head_box}<th>Guest</th><th>Groups</th><th>Status</th>'
                f'<th class="num">Party</th><th>Table</th><th><span class="sr-only">Actions</span></th></tr></thead>'
                f'<tbody>{"".join(trs)}</tbody></table></div>')
        if can_edit:
            cat_opts = "".join(f'<option value="{esc(c)}">{esc(c)}</option>' for c in categories_for(ev))
            body = (f'<form id="bulk" class="toolbar" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/guests/bulk" '
                    f'data-confirm="Apply this to the selected guests?">{csrf(req)}'
                    f'<span class="small muted">With selected:</span>'
                    f'<select class="select select--sm" name="action" aria-label="Bulk action"><option value="category">Set category</option>'
                    f'<option value="pending">Mark as pending</option><option value="delete">Delete</option></select>'
                    f'<select class="select select--sm" name="category" aria-label="Category">{cat_opts}</select>'
                    f'<button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Apply</button>'
                    f'<span class="small muted" style="margin-left:auto">{len(rows)} shown</span></form>') + body
    exports = ""
    if has(ev, "reports"):
        exports = (f'<div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><span class="small muted">Download:</span>'
                   f'<a class="chip" href="{base(ev)}/reports/guests.csv">{i("download")}CSV</a>'
                   f'<a class="chip" href="{base(ev)}/reports/guests.pdf">{i("download")}PDF</a></div>')
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Guests", head + notice + toolbar + body + exports, "/guests")


def _guest_form(req, ev, g=None, f: Form = None) -> str:
    v = dict(g) if g else {"plus_ones_allowed": (ev["guest_settings"] or {}).get("plus_ones_default", 0) or 0,
                           "children_allowed": 0, "email_consent": 1, "status": "pending", "plus_ones": 0, "children": 0}
    if f is not None:
        v.update({k: val for k, val in f.data.items()})
    errors = f.errors if f else {}
    gs = ev.get("guest_settings") or {}
    cats = categories_for(ev)
    groups = sorted(set(gs.get("family_groups") or []) | {r[0] for r in db.q(
        "SELECT DISTINCT family_group FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND family_group != ''", (ev["id"],))})
    sides = gs.get("sides") or []
    meals = events.meal_options(ev["id"])
    datalist = "".join(f'<option value="{esc(x)}">' for x in groups)
    side_html = forms.select("side", "Side", [(s, s) for s in sides], v.get("side", ""), blank="Not set", errors=errors) if sides else ""
    meal_html = forms.select("meal_item_id", "Meal choice", [(m["id"], m["name"]) for m in meals], v.get("meal_item_id") or "",
                             blank="No selection", errors=errors) if meals and has(ev, "menu") else ""
    action = f"{base(ev)}/guests/{g['id']}" if g else f"{base(ev)}/guests/new"
    delete = ""
    if g:
        delete = (f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/guests/{g["id"]}/delete" data-confirm="Remove {esc(events.guest_name(g))} from the guest list?">'
                  f'{csrf(req)}<button class="btn btn--danger btn--sm" type="submit">{i("trash")}Remove guest</button></form>')
    link = ""
    if g and has(ev, "personal_invites"):
        link = (f'<div class="notice">{i("link")}<div><b>Personal invitation link</b><br><span class="mono small" style="overflow-wrap:anywhere">{esc(events.invite_url(ev, g))}</span>'
                f'<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><button class="chip" type="button" data-copy="{esc(events.invite_url(ev, g))}">{i("copy")}Copy</button>'
                f'<a class="chip" href="{esc(guest_whatsapp(ev, g))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{i("chat")}WhatsApp</a></div></div></div>')
    cat_field = forms.select("category", "Category", [(c, c) for c in cats], v.get("category", ""), blank="No category", errors=errors)
    return f"""{forms.errors_summary(errors)}{link}
<form class="form box" method="post" action="{action}" style="margin-top:16px">{csrf(req)}
<fieldset><legend>Who</legend><div class="form-row form-row--2">
{forms.field("first_name", "First name", v.get("first_name", ""), required=True, errors=errors, attrs={"maxlength": 80, "autocomplete": "off"})}
{forms.field("last_name", "Last name", v.get("last_name", ""), errors=errors, attrs={"maxlength": 80, "autocomplete": "off"})}
{forms.field("email", "Email", v.get("email", ""), type="email", errors=errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "off"})}
{forms.field("phone", "Mobile (for WhatsApp)", v.get("phone", ""), type="tel", errors=errors, hint="South African numbers like 082 123 4567 work.")}
</div></fieldset>
<fieldset><legend>Groups</legend><div class="form-row form-row--3">{cat_field}
<div class="field"><label for="f-family-group">Family group</label><input class="input" id="f-family-group" name="family_group" list="groups" value="{esc(v.get("family_group", ""))}" maxlength="80"><datalist id="groups">{datalist}</datalist></div>
{side_html}</div>
<div class="row">{forms.check("is_vip", "VIP guest", bool(v.get("is_vip")))}{forms.check("is_child", "This guest is a child", bool(v.get("is_child")))}</div></fieldset>
<fieldset><legend>Invitation allowances</legend><div class="form-row form-row--2">
{forms.field("plus_ones_allowed", "Plus-ones allowed", v.get("plus_ones_allowed", 0), type="number", errors=errors, attrs={"min": 0, "max": 10})}
{forms.field("children_allowed", "Children allowed", v.get("children_allowed", 0), type="number", errors=errors, attrs={"min": 0, "max": 10})}
</div></fieldset>
<fieldset><legend>Response</legend><div class="form-row form-row--3">
{forms.select("status", "RSVP status", [(k, l) for k, l in STATUS_LABEL.items()], v.get("status", "pending"), errors=errors)}
{forms.field("plus_ones", "Plus-ones coming", v.get("plus_ones", 0), type="number", errors=errors, attrs={"min": 0, "max": 10})}
{forms.field("children", "Children coming", v.get("children", 0), type="number", errors=errors, attrs={"min": 0, "max": 10})}
</div><div class="form-row form-row--2" style="margin-top:16px">
{forms.field("plus_one_names", "Plus-one names", v.get("plus_one_names", ""), errors=errors, attrs={"maxlength": 200})}
{meal_html or "<div></div>"}
{forms.field("dietary", "Dietary requirements", v.get("dietary", ""), errors=errors, attrs={"maxlength": 200})}
{forms.field("allergies", "Allergies", v.get("allergies", ""), errors=errors, attrs={"maxlength": 200})}
</div>{forms.field("special_requests", "Special requests", v.get("special_requests", ""), type="textarea", errors=errors, attrs={"maxlength": 1000, "rows": 3})}</fieldset>
<fieldset><legend>Private</legend>{forms.field("notes", "Organiser notes (never shown to guests)", v.get("notes", ""), type="textarea", errors=errors, attrs={"maxlength": 1000, "rows": 3})}
{forms.check("email_consent", "This guest expects event emails from me", bool(v.get("email_consent")), hint="Untick if the guest hasn't agreed to receive emails. Required by POPIA for direct communication.")}</fieldset>
<div class="row row--between"><a class="btn btn--ghost" href="{base(ev)}/guests">Cancel</a><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">{"Save changes" if g else "Add guest"}</button></div>
</form><div style="margin-top:16px">{delete}</div>"""


def _read_guest(req, ev, g=None) -> Form:
    f = Form(req)
    f.text("first_name", "First name", required=True, max=80)
    f.text("last_name", "Last name", max=80)
    email = f.email("email")
    f.phone("phone")
    f.text("category", max=60)
    f.text("family_group", "Family group", max=80)
    f.text("side", max=60)
    f.flag("is_vip")
    f.flag("is_child")
    f.integer("plus_ones_allowed", "Plus-ones allowed", min=0, max=10)
    f.integer("children_allowed", "Children allowed", min=0, max=10)
    f.choice("status", list(STATUS_LABEL), "status", default="pending")
    f.integer("plus_ones", "Plus-ones coming", min=0, max=10)
    f.integer("children", "Children coming", min=0, max=10)
    f.text("plus_one_names", "Plus-one names", max=200)
    f.text("dietary", "Dietary requirements", max=200)
    f.text("allergies", max=200)
    f.text("special_requests", "Special requests", max=1000)
    f.text("notes", max=1000)
    f.flag("email_consent")
    meal = req.get("meal_item_id")
    f.data["meal_item_id"] = None
    if meal:
        if not db.one("SELECT 1 FROM menu_items WHERE id = ? AND event_id = ? AND selectable = 1", (meal, ev["id"])):
            f.error("meal_item_id", "Choose one of the meal options.")
        else:
            f.data["meal_item_id"] = int(meal)
    if f.data["category"] and f.data["category"] not in categories_for(ev):
        f.error("category", "Choose one of the listed categories.")
    if email:
        dup = db.one("SELECT id FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND email = ? AND id != ?", (ev["id"], email, g["id"] if g else 0))
        if dup:
            f.error("email", "Another guest on this list already uses that email.")
    if f.data["plus_ones"] > max(f.data["plus_ones_allowed"], 0):
        f.error("plus_ones", "Plus-ones coming can't be more than the plus-ones allowed.")
    if f.data["status"] != "attending":
        f.data["plus_ones"] = 0 if f.data["status"] == "declined" else f.data["plus_ones"]
    return f


def _guest_values(f: Form) -> dict:
    keys = ["first_name", "last_name", "email", "phone", "category", "family_group", "side", "plus_ones_allowed",
            "children_allowed", "status", "plus_ones", "children", "plus_one_names", "dietary", "allergies",
            "special_requests", "notes", "meal_item_id"]
    v = {k: f.data[k] for k in keys}
    v["is_vip"] = 1 if f.data["is_vip"] else 0
    v["is_child"] = 1 if f.data["is_child"] else 0
    v["email_consent"] = 1 if f.data["email_consent"] else 0
    return v


def _need_edit(req, ev, title, suffix):
    if not has(ev, "guest_management"):
        return organiser_page(req, ev, title, page_head(title) + locked_panel(ev, "guest_management", "Guest management"), suffix)
    return None


@router.route("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests/new", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def guest_new(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    blocked = _need_edit(req, ev, "Add guest", "/guests")
    if blocked:
        return blocked
    f = None
    if req.method == "POST":
        f = _read_guest(req, ev)
        if f.ok:
            v = _guest_values(f)
            now = db.now()
            v.update({"event_id": ev["id"], "token": events.new_guest_token(), "source": "organiser",
                      "created_at": now, "updated_at": now})
            if v["status"] != "pending":
                v["responded_at"] = now
            db.insert("guests", v)
            req.flash("success", f"{v['first_name']} added to your guest list.")
            return redirect(f"{base(ev)}/guests/new" if req.get("again") else f"{base(ev)}/guests")
    crumbs = f'<p class="small"><a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/guests">Guests</a> / Add guest</p>'
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Add guest", crumbs + page_head("Add a guest") + _guest_form(req, ev, None, f), "/guests")


@router.route("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests/<int:gid>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def guest_edit(req, uid, gid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    blocked = _need_edit(req, ev, "Edit guest", "/guests")
    if blocked:
        return blocked
    g = _guest(ev, gid)
    f = None
    if req.method == "POST":
        f = _read_guest(req, ev, g)
        if f.ok:
            v = _guest_values(f)
            v["updated_at"] = db.now()
            if v["status"] != g["status"] and v["status"] != "pending":
                v["responded_at"] = db.now()
            if v["status"] == "declined":
                db.run("DELETE FROM seat_assignments WHERE guest_id = ?", (g["id"],))
            db.update("guests", g["id"], v)
            req.flash("success", "Guest saved.")
            return redirect(f"{base(ev)}/guests")
    crumbs = f'<p class="small"><a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/guests">Guests</a> / {esc(events.guest_name(g))}</p>'
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Edit guest", crumbs + page_head(events.guest_name(g)) + _guest_form(req, ev, g, f), "/guests")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests/<int:gid>/delete")
def guest_delete(req, uid, gid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if not has(ev, "guest_management"):
        raise HTTPError(403, "Guest management isn't included in this event's package.")
    g = _guest(ev, gid)
    db.run("DELETE FROM guests WHERE id = ?", (g["id"],))
    return go(req, ev, "/guests", "success", f"{events.guest_name(g)} removed.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests/<int:gid>/checkin")
def guest_checkin(req, uid, gid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if not has(ev, "guest_management"):
        raise HTTPError(403, "Attendance tracking isn't included in this event's package.")
    g = _guest(ev, gid)
    db.run("UPDATE guests SET checked_in_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
           (None if g["checked_in_at"] else db.now(), db.now(), g["id"]))
    return go(req, ev, "/guests", "success",
              f"{events.guest_name(g)} {'is no longer checked in' if g['checked_in_at'] else 'checked in'}.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests/bulk")
def guest_bulk(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if not has(ev, "guest_management"):
        raise HTTPError(403, "Guest management isn't included in this event's package.")
    ids = [int(x) for x in req.getlist("ids") if x.isdigit()]
    if not ids:
        return go(req, ev, "/guests", "error", "Select at least one guest first.")
    marks = ",".join("?" for _ in ids)
    action = req.get("action")
    if action == "delete":
        db.run(f"DELETE FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND id IN ({marks})", [ev["id"], *ids])
        return go(req, ev, "/guests", "success", f"Removed {len(ids)} guests.")
    if action == "pending":
        db.run(f"UPDATE guests SET status = 'pending', updated_at = ? WHERE event_id = ? AND id IN ({marks})", [db.now(), ev["id"], *ids])
        return go(req, ev, "/guests", "success", f"{len(ids)} guests marked as pending.")
    cat = req.get("category")
    if cat not in categories_for(ev):
        return go(req, ev, "/guests", "error", "Choose one of the listed categories.")
    db.run(f"UPDATE guests SET category = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE event_id = ? AND id IN ({marks})", [cat, db.now(), ev["id"], *ids])
    return go(req, ev, "/guests", "success", f"Category set to {cat} for {len(ids)} guests.")


# --- CSV import ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IMPORT_COLUMNS = ["first_name", "last_name", "email", "phone", "category", "family_group", "side",
                  "plus_ones_allowed", "children_allowed", "vip", "child"]
ALIASES = {
    "first_name": {"first_name", "first", "firstname", "first name", "given name", "name"},
    "last_name": {"last_name", "last", "lastname", "last name", "surname", "family name"},
    "email": {"email", "e-mail", "email address"},
    "phone": {"phone", "mobile", "cell", "cellphone", "phone number", "whatsapp"},
    "category": {"category", "type", "guest type"},
    "family_group": {"family_group", "family group", "family", "group", "household"},
    "side": {"side"},
    "plus_ones_allowed": {"plus_ones_allowed", "plus ones", "plus-ones", "plus ones allowed", "plus_ones", "+1"},
    "children_allowed": {"children_allowed", "children", "children allowed", "kids"},
    "vip": {"vip"},
    "child": {"child", "is child", "is_child"},
}
MAX_IMPORT = 2000


def parse_import(ev, text: str):
    """Returns (rows, problems). rows are ready-to-insert dicts; problems are (line, message)."""
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text.lstrip("﻿")))
    try:
        header = next(reader)
    except StopIteration:
        return [], [(1, "The file is empty.")]
    mapping = {}
    for idx, h in enumerate(header):
        key = h.strip().lower().replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ")
        for col, names in ALIASES.items():
            if key in {n.replace("_", " ").replace("-", " ") for n in names} and col not in mapping.values():
                mapping[idx] = col
                break
    if "first_name" not in mapping.values():
        return [], [(1, "Add a first_name column (see the template).")]
    existing = {r[0].lower() for r in db.q("SELECT email FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND email != ''", (ev["id"],))}
    seen: set = set()
    rows, problems = [], []
    cats = categories_for(ev)
    sides = (ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("sides") or []
    for line_no, raw in enumerate(reader, start=2):
        if not any(c.strip() for c in raw):
            continue
        if len(rows) >= MAX_IMPORT:
            problems.append((line_no, f"Only {MAX_IMPORT} guests can be imported at once; the rest were skipped."))
            break
        rec = {col: (raw[idx].strip() if idx < len(raw) else "") for idx, col in mapping.items()}
        if not rec.get("first_name"):
            problems.append((line_no, "Missing first name."))
            continue
        if "last_name" not in mapping.values() and " " in rec["first_name"]:
            rec["first_name"], rec["last_name"] = rec["first_name"].split(" ", 1)
        email = rec.get("email", "").lower()
        if email and not forms.EMAIL_RE.match(email):
            problems.append((line_no, f"“{email}” isn't a valid email address."))
            continue
        if email and (email in existing or email in seen):
            problems.append((line_no, f"{email} is already on the guest list."))
            continue
        nums = {}
        bad = False
        for k in ("plus_ones_allowed", "children_allowed"):
            val = rec.get(k, "") or "0"
            if not val.isdigit() or int(val) > 10:
                problems.append((line_no, f"{k.replace('_', ' ').capitalize()} must be a number from 0 to 10."))
                bad = True
                break
            nums[k] = int(val)
        if bad:
            continue
        cat = rec.get("category", "")
        match = next((c for c in cats if c.lower() == cat.lower()), None)
        if cat and not match:
            problems.append((line_no, f"Category “{cat}” isn't one of: {', '.join(cats)}. Imported without a category."))
        side = rec.get("side", "")
        side = next((s for s in sides if s.lower() == side.lower()), "") if side else ""
        seen.add(email)
        rows.append({
            "first_name": rec["first_name"][:80], "last_name": rec.get("last_name", "")[:80], "email": email,
            "phone": rec.get("phone", "")[:30], "category": match or "", "family_group": rec.get("family_group", "")[:80],
            "side": side, "plus_ones_allowed": nums["plus_ones_allowed"], "children_allowed": nums["children_allowed"],
            "is_vip": 1 if rec.get("vip", "").lower() in ("1", "yes", "y", "true", "x") else 0,
            "is_child": 1 if rec.get("child", "").lower() in ("1", "yes", "y", "true", "x") else 0,
        })
    return rows, problems


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests/template.csv")
def guest_template(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    sample = ("﻿first_name,last_name,email,phone,category,family_group,side,plus_ones_allowed,children_allowed,vip,child\r\n"
              "Lerato,Dlamini,lerato@example.com,082 555 0101,Family,Dlamini family,,1,0,yes,\r\n"
              "Pieter,van Wyk,,071 555 0102,Friends,,,0,2,,\r\n")
    return download(sample, f"{ev['slug']}-guest-template.csv", "text/csv; charset=utf-8")


@router.route("/dashboard/events/<uid>/guests/import", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def guest_import(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    blocked = _need_edit(req, ev, "Import guests", "/guests")
    if blocked:
        return blocked
    crumbs = f'<p class="small"><a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/guests">Guests</a> / Import</p>'
    if req.method == "POST":
        text = req.get("csv_text")
        up = req.file("csv")
        if up is not None and up.data:
            if up.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
                req.flash("error", "CSV files must be 2 MB or smaller.")
                return redirect(f"{base(ev)}/guests/import")
            raw = up.data
            try:
                text = raw.decode("utf-8-sig")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                text = raw.decode("cp1252", "replace")
        if not text.strip():
            req.flash("error", "Choose a CSV file or paste your guest list.")
            return redirect(f"{base(ev)}/guests/import")
        rows, problems = parse_import(ev, text)
        if req.get("confirm") == "1":
            now = db.now()
            with db.transaction():
                for r in rows:
                    db.insert("guests", {**r, "event_id": ev["id"], "token": events.new_guest_token(), "source": "import",
                                         "email_consent": 1, "created_at": now, "updated_at": now})
            msg = f"Imported {len(rows)} guests."
            if problems:
                msg += f" {len(problems)} rows were skipped or adjusted."
            req.flash("success", msg)
            return redirect(f"{base(ev)}/guests")
        preview_rows = "".join(
            f'<tr><td>{esc(r["first_name"])} {esc(r["last_name"])}</td><td>{esc(r["email"])}</td><td>{esc(r["phone"])}</td>'
            f'<td>{esc(r["category"])}</td><td>{esc(r["family_group"])}</td><td class="num">{r["plus_ones_allowed"]}</td>'
            f'<td class="num">{r["children_allowed"]}</td></tr>' for r in rows[:200])
        more = f'<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:8px">Showing the first 200 of {len(rows)}.</p>' if len(rows) > 200 else ""
        prob = ""
        if problems:
            items = "".join(f"<li>Line {n}: {esc(m)}</li>" for n, m in problems[:100])
            prob = f'<div class="notice notice--warn" style="margin-bottom:16px">{i("alert")}<div><b>{len(problems)} rows need attention</b><ul style="margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:18px">{items}</ul></div></div>'
        confirm = ""
        if rows:
            confirm = (f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/guests/import" class="row row--between" style="margin-top:16px">{csrf(req)}'
                       f'<input type="hidden" name="confirm" value="1"><textarea name="csv_text" hidden>{esc(text)}</textarea>'
                       f'<a class="btn btn--ghost" href="{base(ev)}/guests/import">Start again</a>'
                       f'<button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Import {len(rows)} guests</button></form>')
        else:
            confirm = f'<p style="margin-top:16px"><a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{base(ev)}/guests/import">Try another file</a></p>'
        table = (f'<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Email</th><th>Phone</th><th>Category</th>'
                 f'<th>Family group</th><th class="num">+1</th><th class="num">Kids</th></tr></thead><tbody>{preview_rows}</tbody></table></div>') if rows else \
            '<div class="empty"><p>No guests could be read from this file.</p></div>'
        body = crumbs + page_head("Check your import", f"{len(rows)} guests ready to import. Nothing is saved until you confirm.") + prob + table + more + confirm
        return organiser_page(req, ev, "Import guests", body, "/guests")
    body = crumbs + page_head("Import guests from a spreadsheet",
                              "Save your spreadsheet as CSV. We'll show you a preview before anything is added.") + f"""
<div class="cols cols--2"><form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/guests/import" enctype="multipart/form-data">{csrf(req)}
<label class="file-drop">{i("upload")}<b>Choose a CSV file</b><span class="small muted">or drag it here · 2 MB max</span><span class="small" data-files></span>
<input type="file" name="csv" accept=".csv,text/csv"></label>
{forms.field("csv_text", "Or paste rows (with the header line)", "", type="textarea", attrs={"rows": 6, "placeholder": "first_name,last_name,email,phone"})}
<div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Preview import</button></div></form>
<div class="box stack" style="--stack:12px"><h2 style="font-size:1.0625rem">Columns we understand</h2>
<p class="small muted">first_name (required), last_name, email, phone, category, family_group, side, plus_ones_allowed, children_allowed, vip, child. Guests whose email is already on your list are skipped.</p>
<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/guests/template.csv">{i("download")}Download the template</a>
<p class="small muted">Categories available: {esc(", ".join(categories_for(ev)))}.</p></div></div>"""
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Import guests", body, "/guests")
```
