```python
"""Checkout, the sandbox test checkout, gateway webhooks, payment status, billing and receipts."""
from __future__ import annotations

from .. import auth, catalog, config, db, events
from ..icons import i
from ..services import payments
from ..web import HTTPError, Response, download, esc, json_response, redirect, router
from .forms import csrf, fmt_dt
from .layout import page
from .shell import account_page, organiser_page, page_head


def _own_order(req, order_uid: str):
    user = auth.require_user(req)
    order = db.one("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE uid = ?", (order_uid,))
    if order is None or (order["user_id"] != user["id"] and user["role"] != "admin"):
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return order


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/checkout")
def checkout(req, uid):
    ev = events.parse(auth.event_for(req, uid))
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can make payments.")
    if not req.get("accept"):
        req.flash("error", "Please accept the terms and refund policy to continue.")
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/10")
    if ev["status"] == "suspended":
        req.flash("error", "This event is suspended. Contact support.")
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/10")
    try:
        order = payments.create_order(ev, req.user, req.get("package"))
        target = payments.gateway().checkout(order)
    except payments.PaymentError as e:
        req.flash("error", str(e))
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/10")
    if "redirect" in target:
        return redirect(target["redirect"])
    inputs = "".join(f'<input type="hidden" name="{esc(k)}" value="{esc(v)}">' for k, v in target["fields"])
    body = f"""<section class="page-hero" style="min-height:70vh;display:grid;align-content:center"><div class="container container--narrow">
<h1>Taking you to secure payment…</h1><p class="lead">You're paying {catalog.money(order["amount_cents"], True)} for {esc(order["description"])}.</p>
<form method="post" action="{esc(target['post_to'])}" id="pf">{inputs}<button class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" type="submit" style="margin-top:24px">Continue to {esc(payments.gateway().label)}</button></form>
<script>document.getElementById('pf').submit();</script></div></section>"""
    return page(req, "Secure payment", body, noindex=True)


# --- built-in sandbox checkout --------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/pay/sandbox/<order_uid>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def sandbox_checkout(req, order_uid):
    if config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY != "sandbox" or not payments.sandbox_allowed():
        raise HTTPError(404)
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    gw = payments.SandboxGateway()
    if req.method == "POST":
        decision = req.get("decision")
        if decision not in ("approve", "decline", "cancel"):
            raise HTTPError(400)
        if order["status"] == "pending":
            body, sig = gw.build_notification(order, decision)
            # Same path as an incoming webhook: signature, freshness and amount are verified.
            payments.apply(gw.verify(body, sig), "sandbox")
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}/payment/{order['uid']}")
    excl, vat = payments.vat_breakdown(order["amount_cents"])
    body = f"""<section class="page-hero" style="padding-bottom:var(--section-y)"><div class="grid-texture"></div><div class="container container--narrow">
<span class="demo-flag">Sandbox · test payment, no money moves</span>
<h1 style="margin-top:16px">Test checkout</h1><p class="lead">This page stands in for the payment gateway while {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)} runs in development. Choose an outcome to send a signed test notification to the server.</p>
<div class="glass glass--strong panel" style="margin-top:28px;display:grid;gap:14px">
<dl class="dl"><dt>Order</dt><dd class="mono">{esc(order['uid'])}</dd><dt>Item</dt><dd>{esc(order['description'])}</dd>
<dt>Amount excl. VAT</dt><dd class="mono">{catalog.money(excl, True)}</dd><dt>VAT ({int(config.VAT_RATE * 100)}%)</dt><dd class="mono">{catalog.money(vat, True)}</dd>
<dt><b>Total</b></dt><dd class="mono"><b>{catalog.money(order['amount_cents'], True)}</b></dd><dt>Status</dt><dd><span class="pill pill--{esc(order['status'])}">{esc(order['status'])}</span></dd></dl>
{'' if order['status'] != 'pending' else f'''<form method="post" class="btn-row">{csrf(req)}
<button class="btn btn--primary" name="decision" value="approve" type="submit">{i("check")} Approve test payment</button>
<button class="btn btn--secondary" name="decision" value="decline" type="submit">Decline</button>
<button class="btn btn--ghost" name="decision" value="cancel" type="submit">Cancel</button></form>'''}
</div></div></section>"""
    return page(req, "Sandbox checkout", body, noindex=True)


@router.get("/pay/cancel/<order_uid>")
def pay_cancel(req, order_uid):
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    if order["status"] == "pending" and not db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE order_id = ?", (order["id"],), 0):
        db.run("UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (db.now(), order["id"]))
    req.flash("info", "Payment cancelled. Nothing was charged.")
    return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}/setup/10")


# --- webhooks (no CSRF: authenticated by signature) ---------------------------------------------------
@router.post("/webhooks/payments/sandbox", csrf=False)
def webhook_sandbox(req):
    if config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY != "sandbox" or not payments.sandbox_allowed():
        raise HTTPError(404)
    notif = payments.SandboxGateway().verify(req.body, req.headers.get("x-aurelia-signature", ""))
    ok, msg = payments.apply(notif, "sandbox")
    return json_response({"ok": notif.valid, "message": msg}, status=200 if notif.valid else 400)


@router.post("/webhooks/payments/payfast", csrf=False)
def webhook_payfast(req):
    if config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY != "payfast":
        raise HTTPError(404)
    gw = payments.PayFastGateway()
    notif = gw.verify_itn(req.body, req.ip)
    payments.apply(notif, "payfast")
    return Response("OK", content_type="text/plain")   # PayFast expects 200 regardless


# --- status / return page ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/api/orders/<order_uid>/status")
def order_status(req, order_uid):
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    return {"status": order["status"], "live": events.is_live(ev), "public_url": events.public_path(ev)}


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/payment/<order_uid>")
def payment_return(req, uid, order_uid):
    ev = events.parse(auth.event_for(req, uid))
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    if order["event_id"] != ev["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    st = order["status"]
    if st == "paid":
        live = events.is_live(ev)
        inner = f"""<div class="empty" style="border-style:solid"><span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">{i("check")}</span>
<h2>Payment confirmed{' and your website is live' if live else ''}</h2>
<p>Receipt {esc(order['invoice_no'])} is in your email. {'Share your link with guests now.' if live else 'Publish your website from Settings when you are ready.'}</p>
<div class="btn-row">{f'<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/dashboard/events/{uid}/share">{i("chat")} Share your link</a>' if live else ''}
<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{events.public_path(ev)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{i("external")} Open website</a>
<a class="btn btn--ghost" href="/dashboard/orders/{order['uid']}/receipt">View receipt</a></div></div>"""
    elif st == "pending":
        inner = f"""<div class="empty" style="border-style:solid" data-poll="/api/orders/{order['uid']}/status"><span class="spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
<h2>Waiting for the payment gateway</h2><p>We publish your website as soon as the gateway confirms payment. This page updates by itself; it usually takes a few seconds.</p>
<a class="btn btn--ghost" href="/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/10">Back to packages</a></div>
<script>(function(){{var box=document.querySelector('[data-poll]'),n=0;function tick(){{fetch(box.getAttribute('data-poll'),{{headers:{{Accept:'application/json'}},credentials:'same-origin'}}).then(function(r){{return r.json();}}).then(function(j){{if(j.status!=='pending'){{location.reload();}}else if(++n<45){{setTimeout(tick,2000);}}else{{box.querySelector('p').textContent='Still waiting. If you completed the payment, it will appear here shortly; you can safely leave this page.';}}}});}}setTimeout(tick,1500);}})();</script>"""
    else:
        inner = f"""<div class="empty" style="border-style:solid"><span class="icon-tile">{i("alert")}</span><h2>Payment {esc(st)}</h2>
<p>Nothing was charged{f": {esc(order['failure_reason'])}" if order['failure_reason'] and order['failure_reason'] != st else ""}. Your event is saved; you can try again.</p>
<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/10">Try again</a></div>"""
    body = page_head("Payment", f"Order {esc(order['uid'])} · {catalog.money(order['amount_cents'], True)}"
                     + (' · <span class="pill pill--sandbox">sandbox</span>' if order["mode"] == "sandbox" else "")) + inner
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Payment", body, "/setup/10")


# --- billing & receipts ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/dashboard/billing")
def billing(req):
    user = auth.require_user(req)
    rows = db.q("""SELECT o.*, e.name AS event_name, e.uid AS event_uid FROM orders o JOIN events e ON e.id = o.event_id
                   WHERE o.user_id = ? ORDER BY o.created_at DESC""", (user["id"],))
    if rows:
        trs = "".join(f"""<tr><td><span class="mono">{esc(o['uid'])}</span><span class="table__sub">{esc(fmt_dt(o['created_at']))}</span></td>
<td><a href="/dashboard/events/{o['event_uid']}">{esc(o['event_name'])}</a><span class="table__sub">{esc(o['description'])}</span></td>
<td class="num mono">{catalog.money(o['amount_cents'], True)}</td><td><span class="pill pill--{esc(o['status'])}">{esc(o['status'])}</span>{' <span class="pill pill--sandbox">sandbox</span>' if o['mode'] == 'sandbox' else ''}</td>
<td>{f'<a href="/dashboard/orders/{o["uid"]}/receipt">Receipt</a>' if o['status'] == 'paid' else ''}</td></tr>""" for o in rows)
        table = f'<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Event</th><th class="num">Amount</th><th>Status</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>{trs}</tbody></table></div>'
    else:
        table = f'<div class="empty"><span class="icon-tile">{i("card")}</span><h2 style="font-size:1.2rem">No orders yet</h2><p>When you choose a package for an event, your orders and receipts appear here.</p></div>'
    return account_page(req, "Orders and receipts", page_head("Orders and receipts", "Every payment and its VAT receipt.") + table, "/dashboard/billing")


@router.get("/dashboard/orders/<order_uid>/receipt")
def receipt(req, order_uid):
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    if order["status"] not in ("paid", "refunded"):
        raise HTTPError(404)
    user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (order["user_id"],))
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    excl, vat = payments.vat_breakdown(order["amount_cents"])
    sandbox_note = "SANDBOX TEST PAYMENT. NOT A TAX INVOICE." if order["mode"] == "sandbox" else ""
    if req.arg("format") == "pdf":
        try:
            from ..services.pdf import PDF
        except ImportError:

        doc = PDF(f"{config.BRAND_NAME} receipt", sandbox_note or "Tax invoice")
        doc.kv([("Invoice", order["invoice_no"] or ""), ("Order", order["uid"]), ("Paid", fmt_dt(order["paid_at"])),
                ("Billed to", f"{user['name']} <{user['email']}>"), ("Event", ev["name"]),
                ("VAT number", config.VAT_NUMBER or "To be confirmed")])
        doc.spacer(10)
        doc.table(["Description", "Excl. VAT", "VAT", "Total"],
                  [[order["description"], catalog.money(excl, True), catalog.money(vat, True), catalog.money(order["amount_cents"], True)]],
                  widths=[0.52, 0.16, 0.14, 0.18])
        doc.spacer(10)
        doc.text(f"{config.BRAND_NAME} · {config.COMPANY_ADDRESS} · {config.SUPPORT_EMAIL}", size=8, muted=True)
        return download(doc.output(), f"{order['invoice_no'] or order['uid']}.pdf", "application/pdf")
    body = f"""{page_head("Receipt", "", f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="?format=pdf">{i("download")} PDF</a><button class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm no-print" type="button" onclick="window.print()">{i("print")} Print</button>')}
<article class="box" style="max-width:760px">{f'<p class="demo-flag" style="margin-bottom:16px">{esc(sandbox_note)}</p>' if sandbox_note else ''}
<div class="row row--between" style="align-items:flex-start"><div><h2 style="font-size:1.4rem">{"Tax invoice" if not sandbox_note else "Receipt"}</h2><p class="muted small">{esc(config.BRAND_NAME)} · {esc(config.COMPANY_ADDRESS)}<br>VAT no. {esc(config.VAT_NUMBER or "to be confirmed")}</p></div>
<div class="small" style="text-align:right"><b class="mono">{esc(order['invoice_no'] or '')}</b><br><span class="muted">{esc(fmt_dt(order['paid_at']))}</span></div></div><hr>
<dl class="dl"><dt>Billed to</dt><dd>{esc(user['name'])}<br><span class="muted">{esc(user['email'])}</span></dd><dt>Event</dt><dd>{esc(ev['name'])}</dd><dt>Order</dt><dd class="mono">{esc(order['uid'])}</dd>
<dt>Description</dt><dd>{esc(order['description'])}</dd><dt>Amount excl. VAT</dt><dd class="mono">{catalog.money(excl, True)}</dd><dt>VAT ({int(config.VAT_RATE * 100)}%)</dt><dd class="mono">{catalog.money(vat, True)}</dd>
<dt><b>Total paid</b></dt><dd class="mono"><b>{catalog.money(order['amount_cents'], True)}</b></dd><dt>Status</dt><dd><span class="pill pill--{esc(order['status'])}">{esc(order['status'])}</span></dd></dl></article>"""
    return account_page(req, "Receipt", body, "/dashboard/billing")
```

### `app/views/public_event.py`

<!-- FILE: app/views/public_event.py sha256=740cf80a76228110c80f75404703622d1260f06ea8c485909f627f2b92f6e512 nl=1 -->
```python
"""Guest-facing event websites: public page, personal invitations, RSVP, unsubscribe, calendar,
plus the organiser preview and the template-gallery sample render."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

from .. import auth, catalog, config, db, events, notify
from ..eventsite import render as R
from ..eventsite import themes
from ..eventsite.demo import demo_event
from ..services import email as mail
from ..web import HTTPError, Response, esc, redirect, router
from .forms import EMAIL_RE, Form


def is_available(ev) -> bool:
    """Guests may open the site: published, paid, not suspended, inside the hosting period."""
    if not events.is_live(ev):
        return False
    hu = ev.get("hosting_until")
    if hu:
        try:
            if date.today() > date.fromisoformat(hu[:10]):
                return False
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return True


def simple_page(ev, title: str, body: str, status: int = 200) -> Response:
    """A small themed page (unavailable, unsubscribe) using the event's palette when known."""
    style, fonts = "", ""
    if ev:
        t = themes.resolve(R.design_key(ev), ev.get("design") or {})
        style = themes.css_vars(t) + R.contrast_vars(t["colors"])
        fonts = f'<link rel="stylesheet" href="{esc(themes.fonts_url(t["display"], t["body"]))}">'
    html = f"""<!doctype html><html lang="en-ZA"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{esc(title)}</title><meta name="robots" content="noindex"><link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">{fonts}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/eventsite.css"></head>
<body class="ev ev-simple" style="{style}"><main class="ev-simple__card">{body}
<p class="ev-made"><a href="/">Made with {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)}</a></p></main></body></html>"""
    return Response(html, status=status)


def unavailable(ev=None) -> Response:
    body = ('<h1>This event page isn\'t available</h1><p>The link may be private, the page may not be published yet, '
            'or the event has ended. If you were invited, please check with the hosts.</p>')
    return simple_page(ev, "Event page not available", body, 404)


def _load(slug: str):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return ev


@router.get("/events/<slug:slug>")
def event_page(req, slug):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        return unavailable()
    if is_available(ev):
        return Response(R.render(ev, "public", None, req))
    if auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev):
        return Response(R.render(ev, "preview", None, req, notice="Guests see an 'unavailable' page until it is published"))
    return unavailable(ev)


def _guest(ev, token: str):
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (token, ev["id"]))
    if g is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return g


@router.get("/events/<slug:slug>/i/<token>")
def invitation(req, slug, token):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        return unavailable()
    guest = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (token, ev["id"]))
    if guest is None:
        return unavailable(ev)
    if is_available(ev):
        return Response(R.render(ev, "public", guest, req))
    if auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev):
        return Response(R.render(ev, "preview", guest, req, notice=f"Personal link for {events.guest_name(guest)}"))
    return unavailable(ev)


# --- RSVP -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STATUS_TEXT_GUEST = {"attending": "attending", "declined": "not attending"}
STATUS_TEXT_ORG = {"attending": "is attending", "declined": "can't attend"}


def _rerender(req, ev, guest, form, status=400):
    values = {k: (",".join(v) if k == "dietary" else v[0]) for k, v in req.form.items() if k != "_csrf"}
    return Response(R.render(ev, "public", guest, req, form={"errors": form.errors, "values": values}), status=status)


@router.post("/events/<slug:slug>/rsvp")
def rsvp(req, slug):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None or not is_available(ev):
        return unavailable(ev)
    token = req.get("token")
    guest = _guest(ev, token) if token else None
    back = f"/events/{ev['slug']}" + (f"/i/{guest['token']}" if guest else "")
    if req.get("website"):  # honeypot: pretend all is well
        return redirect(back + "?rsvp=thanks#rsvp")
    if auth.rate_limited(f"rsvp:{req.ip}", 30, 600):
        raise HTTPError(429, "Too many replies from this connection. Please wait a few minutes and try again.")
    closed = R.rsvp_closed(ev)
    if closed:
        return Response(R.render(ev, "public", guest, req, notice=closed), status=409)

    f = Form(req)
    status = f.choice("status", ["attending", "declined"], "answer", required=True)
    if not status and "status" not in f.errors:
        f.error("status", "Tell us whether you'll attend.")
    if guest is None:
        first = f.text("first_name", "First name", required=True, max=80)
        last = f.text("last_name", "Surname", required=True, max=80)
        email_addr = f.email("email", required=True)
        phone = f.phone("phone")
    allow = R.allowances(ev, guest)
    plus = f.integer("plus_ones", "Guests joining you", min=0, max=allow["plus_ones"]) if allow["plus_ones"] else 0
    kids = f.integer("children", "Children", min=0, max=allow["children"]) if allow["children"] else 0
    plus_names = f.text("plus_one_names", "Their names", max=300) if allow["plus_ones"] else ""
    special = f.text("special_requests", "Message", max=1000)
    meal_id = None
    meal_options = {m["id"]: m for m in events.meal_options(ev["id"])}
    if meal_options and catalog.has_feature(ev, "menu", public=True) and events.visible_sections(ev)["menu"]:
        raw = f.text("meal_item_id", "Meal choice", max=12)
        if raw:
            try:
                meal_id = int(raw)
            except ValueError:
                meal_id = None
            if meal_id not in meal_options:
                f.error("meal_item_id", "Choose one of the listed meals.")
                meal_id = None
    dietary, allergies = "", ""
    if catalog.has_feature(ev, "dietary", public=True):
        offered = set(ev["info"].get("dietary_options") or events.DIETARY_OPTIONS)
        dietary = ", ".join(d for d in req.getlist("dietary") if d in offered)
        allergies = f.text("allergies", "Allergies", max=300)
    funcs = events.functions(ev["id"])
    multi = len(funcs) > 1 and catalog.has_feature(ev, "multi_functions", public=True)
    chosen_funcs = set()
    if multi:
        valid = {fn["id"] for fn in funcs}
        for x in req.getlist("functions"):
            if x.isdigit() and int(x) in valid:
                chosen_funcs.add(int(x))
        if status == "attending" and not chosen_funcs:
            f.error("functions", "Choose at least one part of the celebration.")
    if not f.ok:
        return _rerender(req, ev, guest, f)
    if status == "declined":
        plus, kids, plus_names, meal_id, dietary, allergies = 0, 0, "", None, "", ""

    now = db.now()
    via = "personal" if guest else "general"
    with db.transaction():
        if guest is None:
            existing = db.one("""SELECT * FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND email = ? AND status = 'pending'
                                 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1""", (ev["id"], email_addr))
            if existing is not None:
                guest_id = existing["id"]
                db.update("guests", guest_id, {"phone": existing["phone"] or phone})
            else:
                guest_id = db.insert("guests", {
                    "event_id": ev["id"], "token": events.new_guest_token(), "first_name": first, "last_name": last,
                    "email": email_addr, "phone": phone, "source": "general_link",
                    "plus_ones_allowed": allow["plus_ones"], "children_allowed": allow["children"],
                    "invited_at": None, "created_at": now, "updated_at": now})
        else:
            guest_id = guest["id"]
        db.update("guests", guest_id, {
            "status": status, "plus_ones": plus, "plus_one_names": plus_names, "children": kids,
            "meal_item_id": meal_id, "dietary": dietary, "allergies": allergies, "special_requests": special,
            "responded_at": now, "updated_at": now})
        if multi:
            db.run("DELETE FROM guest_functions WHERE guest_id = ?", (guest_id,))
            for fn in funcs:
                db.insert("guest_functions", {"guest_id": guest_id, "function_id": fn["id"],
                                              "attending": 1 if (status == "attending" and fn["id"] in chosen_funcs) else 0})
        db.insert("rsvp_responses", {"event_id": ev["id"], "guest_id": guest_id, "via": via, "created_at": now,
                                     "payload": db.dumps({"status": status, "plus_ones": plus, "plus_one_names": plus_names,
                                                          "children": kids, "meal_item_id": meal_id, "dietary": dietary,
                                                          "allergies": allergies, "special_requests": special,
                                                          "functions": sorted(chosen_funcs)})})
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE id = ?", (guest_id,))
    _notify(ev, g)
    return redirect(f"/events/{ev['slug']}/i/{g['token']}?rsvp=thanks#rsvp" if guest else back + "?rsvp=thanks#rsvp")


def _notify(ev, g) -> None:
    details = notify.rsvp_details_html(ev, g)
    try:
        if notify.can_email_guest(g):
            v = {**notify.event_vars(ev), **notify.guest_vars(ev, g),
                 "status_text": STATUS_TEXT_GUEST.get(g["status"], g["status"]), "details": details}
            mail.send(g["email"], "rsvp_confirmation", v, event_id=ev["id"], guest_id=g["id"])
        if (ev.get("report_prefs") or {}).get("new_rsvp", True):
            st = events.stats(ev["id"])
            notify.organiser(ev, "new_rsvp", {"guest_name": events.guest_name(g),
                                              "status_text": STATUS_TEXT_ORG.get(g["status"], g["status"]),
                                              "details": details, "attending": st["attending"],
                                              "declined": st["declined"], "pending": st["pending"]})
    except Exception as e:  # never lose an RSVP because an email failed
        import sys
        print(f"[rsvp] notification failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)


# --- unsubscribe ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/events/<slug:slug>/u/<token>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def unsubscribe(req, slug, token):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        return unavailable()
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (token, ev["id"]))
    if g is None:
        return unavailable(ev)
    host = esc(events.title(ev))
    if req.method == "POST":
        db.update("guests", g["id"], {"unsubscribed_at": db.now(), "email_consent": 0, "updated_at": db.now()})
        body = (f"<h1>You won't receive more emails</h1><p>We've stopped event emails from {host} to "
                f"{esc(g['email'] or 'you')}. Your RSVP is unchanged, and the event page still works from your link.</p>"
                f'<p><a class="ev-btn ev-btn--ghost" href="/events/{esc(ev["slug"])}/i/{esc(g["token"])}">Back to the event</a></p>')
        return simple_page(ev, "Unsubscribed", body)
    if g["unsubscribed_at"]:
        body = f"<h1>You're already unsubscribed</h1><p>You won't receive event emails from {host}.</p>"
        return simple_page(ev, "Unsubscribed", body)
    body = (f"<h1>Stop event emails?</h1><p>You'll no longer receive invitations, reminders or updates about "
            f"<b>{esc(ev['name'])}</b> from {host}. Under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) you can "
            f"withdraw consent at any time; we'll record the date you did.</p>"
            f'<form method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{esc(req.csrf)}">'
            f'<button class="ev-btn" type="submit">Stop emails</button></form>')
    return simple_page(ev, "Unsubscribe", body)


# --- calendar -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _ics_text(s: str) -> str:
    return (s or "").replace("\\", "\\\\").replace(";", "\\;").replace(",", "\\,").replace("\n", "\\n")


@router.get("/events/<slug:slug>/calendar.ics")
def calendar(req, slug):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None or not (is_available(ev) or auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev)) or not ev.get("event_date"):
        return unavailable(ev)
    start = datetime.fromisoformat(f"{ev['event_date']}T{ev.get('start_time') or '12:00'}") - timedelta(hours=2)
    if ev.get("end_time"):
        end = datetime.fromisoformat(f"{ev['event_date']}T{ev['end_time']}") - timedelta(hours=2)
        if end <= start:
            end += timedelta(days=1)
    else:
        end = start + timedelta(hours=4)
    fmt = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"
    v = ev.get("venue") or {}
    loc = ", ".join(x for x in (v.get("name"), v.get("address")) if x)
    lines = ["BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", f"PRODID:-//{config.BRAND_NAME}//Events//EN", "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
             "BEGIN:VEVENT", f"UID:{ev['uid']}@{config.BRAND_NAME.lower()}",
             f"DTSTAMP:{datetime.utcnow().strftime(fmt)}", f"DTSTART:{start.strftime(fmt)}", f"DTEND:{end.strftime(fmt)}",
             f"SUMMARY:{_ics_text(ev['name'])}", f"LOCATION:{_ics_text(loc)}", f"URL:{events.public_url(ev)}",
             f"DESCRIPTION:{_ics_text('Details and RSVP: ' + events.public_url(ev))}", "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR"]
    r = Response("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n", content_type="text/calendar; charset=utf-8")
    r.header("Content-Disposition", f'attachment; filename="{ev["slug"]}.ics"')
    return r


# --- previews --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/templates/<slug:slug>/preview")
def template_preview(req, slug):
    t = catalog.template(slug)
    if t is None or not t["active"]:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    groups = db.loads(t["groups"], [])
    group = req.arg("group") if req.arg("group") in ("weddings", "baby", "parties", "other") else (groups[0] if groups else "weddings")
    r = Response(R.render(demo_event(slug, group), "demo", None, req))
    r.header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
    return r


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/preview")
def organiser_preview(req, uid):
    row = auth.event_for(req, uid)
    ev = events.parse(row)
    gtoken = req.arg("guest")
    guest = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (gtoken, ev["id"])) if gtoken else None
    r = Response(R.render(ev, "preview", guest, req))
    r.header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    return r
```

```python
"""Navigation for the organiser dashboard and the admin dashboard.

Every dashboard page renders through `organiser_page()` or `admin_page()` so the sidebar and
locked-feature markers stay consistent across modules.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from .. import catalog, events
from ..icons import i
from ..web import esc
from .layout import app_shell, side_link


# (path suffix, label, icon, feature needed)
EVENT_NAV = [
    ("", "Overview", "dashboard", None),
    ("/setup/1", "Event setup", "wand", None),
    ("/guests", "Guests", "users", "basic_dashboard"),
    ("/rsvps", "RSVPs", "check", "basic_dashboard"),
    ("/seating", "Seating", "seat", "seating"),
    ("/menu", "Menu", "dish", "menu"),
    ("/programme", "Programme", "list", "programme"),
    ("/communications", "Communications", "mail", "email_notifications"),
    ("/share", "Share", "chat", None),
    ("/reports", "Reports", "file", "basic_dashboard"),
    ("/settings", "Settings", "settings", None),
]


def event_nav(ev, current: str) -> str:
    base = f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}"
    status = events.STATUS_LABELS.get(ev["status"], ev["status"])
    pill_kind = ev["status"]
    paid = catalog.package(ev["paid_package"])
    pkg_line = paid["name"] if paid else "Not paid yet"
    links = []
    for suffix, label, icon, feature in EVENT_NAV:
        href = base + suffix
        cur = current if not suffix.startswith("/setup") else (href if current.startswith(base + "/setup") else current)
        locked = feature is not None and not catalog.has_feature(ev, feature)
        links.append(side_link(href, label, icon, cur, locked))
    return (f'<a class="side-link" href="/dashboard">{i("arrow-left")}<span>All events</span></a>'
            f'<div class="side-event"><b>{esc(ev["name"])}</b><span>{esc(pkg_line)}</span>'
            f'<div style="margin-top:8px"><span class="pill pill--{esc(pill_kind)}">{esc(status)}</span></div></div>'
            + "".join(links) +
            f'<div class="side-group"><a class="side-link" href="{events.public_path(ev)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{i("external")}<span>View website</span></a></div>')


def account_nav(current: str, user) -> str:
    links = [
        side_link("/dashboard", "My events", "home", current),
        side_link("/create", "Create an event", "plus", current),
        side_link("/dashboard/billing", "Orders and receipts", "card", current),
        side_link("/account", "Account", "user", current),
        side_link("/contact", "Help and support", "support", current),
    ]
    if user is not None and user["role"] == "admin":
        links.append('<div class="side-group"><div class="side-group__label">Platform</div>'
                     + side_link("/admin", "Admin dashboard", "shield", current) + "</div>")
    return "".join(links)


ADMIN_NAV = [
    ("/admin", "Overview", "chart"),
    ("/admin/customers", "Customers", "users"),
    ("/admin/events", "Events", "calendar"),
    ("/admin/orders", "Payments", "card"),
    ("/admin/hosting", "Hosting periods", "clock"),
    ("/admin/packages", "Packages", "tag"),
    ("/admin/templates", "Templates", "layout"),
    ("/admin/categories", "Categories", "list"),
    ("/admin/emails", "Email templates", "mail"),
    ("/admin/outbox", "Email log", "send"),
    ("/admin/support", "Support", "support"),
    ("/admin/audit", "Audit log", "shield"),
]


def admin_nav(current: str) -> str:
    return (side_link("/dashboard", "Back to my events", "arrow-left", current)
            + '<div class="side-group"><div class="side-group__label">Administration</div>'
            + "".join(side_link(h, l, ic, current) for h, l, ic in ADMIN_NAV) + "</div>")


def organiser_page(req, ev, title: str, body: str, current_suffix: str = "", extra_head: str = "",
                   extra_scripts: str = "") -> str:
    current = f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}{current_suffix}"
    return app_shell(req, f"{title} · {ev['name']}", body, event_nav(ev, current), ev, extra_head, extra_scripts)


def account_page(req, title: str, body: str, current: str = "/dashboard", extra_head: str = "") -> str:
    return app_shell(req, title, body, account_nav(current, req.user), None, extra_head)


def admin_page(req, title: str, body: str, current: str = "/admin", extra_head: str = "", extra_scripts: str = "") -> str:
    return app_shell(req, f"{title} · Admin", body, admin_nav(current), None, extra_head, extra_scripts)


def locked_panel(ev, feature: str, what: str) -> str:
    """Shown in place of a tool the event's package doesn't include."""
    need = next((p for p in catalog.packages() if feature in catalog.package_features(p["code"])), None)
    name = need["name"] if need else "a higher package"
    tile = '<span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">' + i("lock") + "</span>"
    return (f'<div class="empty">{tile}'
            f'<h2 style="font-size:1.25rem">{esc(what)} is part of the {esc(name)}</h2>'
            f'<p>Upgrade this event to unlock it. You only pay the difference.</p>'
            f'<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/dashboard/events/{ev["uid"]}/setup/10">See packages</a></div>')


def page_head(title: str, intro: str = "", actions: str = "") -> str:
    return (f'<div class="page-head"><div><h1>{esc(title)}</h1>{f"<p>{intro}</p>" if intro else ""}</div>'
            f'{f"<div class=btn-row>{actions}</div>" if actions else ""}</div>')
```

```python
"""Event creation: /create (choose occasion and template) and the 10-step set-up wizard.

Each step is its own form at /dashboard/events/<uid>/setup/<n>. Saving never publishes
anything; the event stays a private draft until a verified payment (step 10).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from .. import auth, catalog, config, db, events

from ..icons import i
from ..services import storage
from ..web import HTTPError, esc, json_response, redirect, router, url

from .layout import page
from .shell import organiser_page

STEPS = [
    (1, "Event details", "calendar"), (2, "Venue", "pin"), (3, "Design", "palette"), (4, "Guests", "users"),
    (5, "Programme", "list"), (6, "Food and drinks", "dish"), (7, "Seating", "seat"), (8, "Extras", "gift"),
```
