```css
.chip .count { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: .75rem; opacity: .7; }
.chips-scroll { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* 6. Cards & glass ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.card {
  position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; min-width: 0;
  padding: var(--pad-card); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi);
  transition: transform var(--t-move) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--t-fast), box-shadow var(--t-move) var(--ease-out);
}
.section--surface .card { background: var(--color-bg); }
.card--link:hover { transform: translateY(var(--lift)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 18%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi), var(--shadow-lg); }
.card__title { font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + .3vw, 1.25rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.022em; line-height: 1.25; }
.card__title a { text-decoration: none; }
.card__title a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; }
.card__text { font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.card__foot { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.card__media { margin: calc(var(--pad-card) * -1) calc(var(--pad-card) * -1) 4px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg) 0 0; background: var(--color-surface-2); }
.card__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform var(--t-slow) var(--ease-out); }
.card--link:hover .card__media img { transform: scale(var(--zoom)); }

/* Glass: frosted, transparent, with a specular top edge (the "glossy" layer) */
.glass {
  position: relative; background: var(--glass); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass);
}
.glass::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .55) 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / .08) 28%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 55%);
  mix-blend-mode: soft-light; opacity: .9;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .glass::after, .on-dark .glass::after { background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .16) 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / .02) 30%, transparent 55%); mix-blend-mode: normal; }
.glass--strong { background: var(--glass-strong); }
.panel { padding: var(--pad-card); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); }
.icon-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-text); transition: color var(--t-fast), border-color var(--t-fast), transform var(--t-move) var(--ease-out); }
.icon-tile .i { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.card:hover .icon-tile, .feature:hover .icon-tile { color: var(--color-accent-text); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 45%, transparent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.icon-tile--soft { background: var(--color-accent-soft); color: var(--color-accent-text); border-color: transparent; }

/* 7. Header ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.site-header { position: fixed; inset: 0 0 auto 0; z-index: 50; padding: 0; transition: padding var(--t-move) var(--ease-out); }
.site-header__bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; height: var(--header-h);
  max-width: calc(var(--container) + 2 * var(--gutter)); margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--gutter);
  border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0;
  transition: height var(--t-move) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--t-move), border-color var(--t-move), box-shadow var(--t-move), border-radius var(--t-move), max-width var(--t-move);
}
.site-header.is-scrolled { padding: 8px 8px 0; }
.site-header.is-scrolled .site-header__bar {
  height: 60px; border-radius: 18px; max-width: calc(var(--container) + 2 * var(--gutter) - 16px);
  background: var(--glass-strong); border-color: var(--glass-border);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow), var(--inset-hi);
}
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 650; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.brand__mark { width: 30px; height: 30px; }
.brand__name { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.nav { display: none; margin-left: 12px; }
.nav ul { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; opacity: .78; transition: opacity var(--t-fast), background-color var(--t-fast); position: relative; }
.nav a:hover { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 7%, transparent); }
.nav a[aria-current="page"] { opacity: 1; }
.nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 3px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-accent); }
.header-actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.header-actions .btn--primary { display: none; }
.menu-btn { display: inline-flex; }
@media (min-width: 560px) { .header-actions .btn--primary { display: inline-flex; } }
@media (min-width: 1100px) { .nav { display: block; } .menu-btn { display: none; } }
.theme-toggle .i--moon { display: none; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .i--sun { display: none; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .i--moon { display: inline-block; }

.drawer { position: fixed; inset: 0 0 0 auto; margin: 0 0 0 auto; width: min(100%, 460px); height: 100%; max-height: none; padding: 0; border: 0; color: var(--band-text); background: radial-gradient(120% 60% at 100% 100%, rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .3), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(80% 40% at 0% 0%, rgb(var(--glow-blush) / .16), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--band-bg-2), var(--band-bg)); }
.drawer::backdrop { background: rgb(10 8 9 / .45); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
.drawer[open] { animation: drawer-in 550ms var(--ease-out); }
@keyframes drawer-in { from { translate: 100% 0; } }
.drawer__head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 72px; padding: 0 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--band-line); }
.drawer nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 60px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--band-line); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.02em; text-decoration: none; }
.drawer nav a[aria-current="page"] { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--color-accent); }
.drawer__foot { padding: 24px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }

/* 8. Heroes ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.hero { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; padding: calc(var(--header-h) + clamp(40px, 7vw, 96px)) 0 clamp(48px, 7vw, 96px); }
.hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -2; background:
  radial-gradient(42% 46% at 8% 12%, rgb(var(--glow-blush) / .32), transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(40% 50% at 92% 8%, rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .3), transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(46% 50% at 70% 92%, rgb(var(--glow-mint) / .28), transparent 72%),
  radial-gradient(36% 40% at 22% 88%, rgb(var(--glow-peach) / .26), transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(90% 60% at 50% 0%, var(--hero-glow), transparent 62%); }
.hero__haze { position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: auto -10% -30% -10%; height: 70%; background: radial-gradient(40% 50% at 70% 40%, rgb(var(--glow-sky) / .28), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 45% at 55% 55%, rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .2), transparent 70%); pointer-events: none; }
.hero__title { font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 1rem + 5vw, 4.75rem); font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.055em; max-width: 15ch; }
.hero__title .serif { font-size: 1.08em; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.hero__sub { margin-top: 22px; max-width: 54ch; font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + .5vw, 1.3125rem); color: var(--color-muted); }
.hero__actions { margin-top: 32px; }
.hero__note { margin-top: 20px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 20px; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.hero__note span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.hero__note .i { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--color-accent-text); }
.hero-grid { display: grid; gap: 48px; align-items: center; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, .95fr); } }

/* Signature visual: one link fanning out to the whole event, in glass */
.orbit { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.02; width: min(100%, 560px); margin-inline: auto; perspective: 1200px; }
.orbit__lines { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.orbit__lines path { fill: none; stroke: rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .55); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-dasharray: 3 6; }
.orbit__lines circle { fill: rgb(var(--glow-accent)); }
.orbit__ring { position: absolute; inset: 9%; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.orbit__ring--2 { inset: 22%; border-style: dashed; opacity: .7; }
.phone {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 46%; aspect-ratio: 9 / 18.6; translate: -50% -50%;
  border-radius: 34px; padding: 9px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F3EEFC, #D9CFF3 55%, #C8BBEC);
  box-shadow: 0 40px 80px -30px rgb(80 50 140 / .45), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / .8), inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .9);
  transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 700ms var(--ease-out);
}
.phone__screen { position: relative; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 26px; background: #FCF8FC; color: #2B2238; }
.phone__screen::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(125deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .35) 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 34%); pointer-events: none; }
.phone__notch { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 50%; translate: -50% 0; width: 34%; height: 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: #2B2238; z-index: 2; }
.mini-site { height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 38px 14px 14px; gap: 8px; background: radial-gradient(90% 40% at 20% 0%, #F9DCE6, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(90% 40% at 90% 5%, #E6DEFB, transparent 70%), #FCF8FC; }
.mini-site__mono { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #B8A4F0; display: grid; place-items: center; font: italic 400 1.1rem/1 var(--font-serif); color: #5A44A3; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .6); }
.mini-site__kicker { font-size: .5rem; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5A44A3; }
.mini-site__names { font: italic 400 1.45rem/1.05 var(--font-serif); letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.mini-site__date { font: 500 .55rem/1.4 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; color: #6c615a; }
.mini-site__count { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 4px; width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; }
.mini-site__count div { padding: 6px 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #EAE3F7; font: 600 .7rem/1 var(--font-mono); }
.mini-site__count small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font: 400 .42rem/1 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8b7f76; }
.mini-site__btn { margin-top: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 9px 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E4DBFB, #CDBFF4 52%, #BBA9EE); color: #231A3E; font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .8); }
.mini-site__img { width: 100%; flex: 1; min-height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background:
  radial-gradient(60% 80% at 25% 100%, #D3F0E4 0, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(55% 70% at 85% 90%, #F9DCE6 0, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, #EEE8FD, #DCE8FB); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.mini-site__img::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 22% 30% 0; border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .7); }
.float-tile { position: absolute; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: .8125rem; min-width: 150px; transition: transform 700ms var(--ease-out); }
.float-tile b { display: block; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.float-tile .muted { font-size: .75rem; }
.float-tile--rsvp { left: 0; top: 14%; }
.float-tile--seat { right: 0; top: 30%; }
.float-tile--menu { left: 2%; bottom: 14%; }
.float-tile--link { right: 4%; bottom: 6%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 14px 8px 8px; }
.float-tile--link .dot { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--gold-sheen); color: var(--btn-text); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .8); }
.float-tile--link .dot .i { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.ring-stat { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.ring-stat svg { width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: none; rotate: -90deg; }
.ring-stat circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 4; }
.ring-stat .track { stroke: var(--color-line); }
.ring-stat .val { stroke: var(--color-accent); stroke-linecap: round; }
@media (max-width: 479px) { .float-tile { min-width: 0; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: .75rem; } .float-tile b { font-size: .9rem; } .float-tile--menu { display: none; } }

.page-hero { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; padding: calc(var(--header-h) + clamp(32px, 6vw, 72px)) 0 clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.page-hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -2; background: radial-gradient(45% 80% at 92% 0%, rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .26), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 70% at 65% 0%, rgb(var(--glow-blush) / .22), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(30% 60% at 100% 100%, rgb(var(--glow-mint) / .2), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(70% 70% at 85% 0%, var(--hero-glow), transparent 60%); }
.page-hero .grid-texture { -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 90% 0%, #000 20%, transparent 70%); mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 90% 0%, #000 20%, transparent 70%); }
.page-hero h1 { max-width: 22ch; }
.page-hero .lead { margin-top: 16px; }
.breadcrumbs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.breadcrumbs a { text-decoration: none; min-height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.breadcrumbs a:hover { color: var(--color-text); }
.breadcrumbs span[aria-hidden] { opacity: .5; }

/* 9. Marketing blocks -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.cat-tile { position: relative; min-height: 260px; padding: var(--pad-card); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; text-decoration: none; isolation: isolate; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); transition: transform var(--t-move) var(--ease-out), box-shadow var(--t-move) var(--ease-out); }
.cat-tile:hover { transform: translateY(var(--lift)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.cat-tile__art { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; transition: transform var(--t-slow) var(--ease-out); }
.cat-tile:hover .cat-tile__art { transform: scale(var(--zoom)); }
.cat-tile__art::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 30%, var(--color-surface) 92%); }
.cat-tile h3 { font-size: 1.375rem; }
.cat-tile p { font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.cat-tile .arrow-link { margin-top: 4px; }

.tpl-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi); overflow: hidden; transition: transform var(--t-move) var(--ease-out), box-shadow var(--t-move) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--t-fast); }
.tpl-card:hover { transform: translateY(var(--lift)); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi), var(--shadow-lg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 16%, transparent); }
.tpl-card__stage { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3.1; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-surface-2); }
.tpl-card__stage iframe { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 1280px; height: 992px; border: 0; transform-origin: 0 0; pointer-events: none; }
.tpl-card__stage::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .22), transparent 35%); pointer-events: none; }
.tpl-card__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 18px 20px 20px; flex: 1; }
.tpl-card__row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.tpl-card h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; }
.tpl-card h3 a { text-decoration: none; }
.tpl-card h3 a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.tpl-card__dir { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-accent-text); font-weight: 500; }
.tpl-card__foot { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: auto; display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-top: 8px; }

.steps { counter-reset: step; display: grid; gap: 28px; position: relative; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .steps { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap); } }
.step { position: relative; padding-top: 34px; }
.step::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 0; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-text); background: var(--color-bg); z-index: 1; }
.step:last-child::before { background: var(--color-accent); border-color: var(--color-accent); }
.step::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 20px; right: -12px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-text), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 12%, transparent)); opacity: .5; }
.step:last-child::after { display: none; }
.step h3 { font-size: 1.125rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.step p { font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--color-muted); }

.feature { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.feature h3 { font-size: 1.0625rem; }
.feature p { font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--color-muted); }

.price-grid { display: grid; gap: var(--gap); }
@media (min-width: 960px) { .price-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: stretch; } }
.price { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi); }
.price--highlight { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 60%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi), 0 40px 80px -48px rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .8); background: radial-gradient(80% 40% at 100% 0%, rgb(var(--glow-blush) / .22), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-soft) 80%, var(--color-surface)), var(--color-surface) 45%); }
.price__badge { position: absolute; top: -13px; left: 50%; translate: -50% 0; height: 26px; padding: 0 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--gold-sheen); color: var(--btn-text); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .02em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .8); }
.price h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; }
.price__amount { font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 1.6rem + 2vw, 3rem); font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.05em; line-height: 1; }
.price__amount small { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--color-muted); margin-left: 6px; }
.price ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 10px; font-size: .9375rem; }
.price li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; }
.price li .i { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--color-accent-text); }
.price li.is-first { font-weight: 600; }
.price__limits { padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); display: grid; gap: 6px; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.price__limits div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.price__limits b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text); }
.price .btn { margin-top: auto; }

.compare { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .9375rem; }
.compare th, .compare td { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); text-align: center; }
.compare th:first-child, .compare td:first-child { text-align: left; }
.compare thead th { font-size: .875rem; position: sticky; top: calc(var(--header-h) + 8px); background: var(--color-surface); }
.compare .yes { color: var(--color-accent-text); }
.compare .no { color: var(--color-border-strong); }

.faq { display: grid; gap: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.faq details { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.faq summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 68px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-weight: 550; font-size: 1.0625rem; letter-spacing: -.015em; }
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.faq summary::after { content: "+"; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); font-weight: 400; transition: rotate var(--t-move) var(--ease-out); }
.faq details[open] summary::after { rotate: 45deg; }
.faq details > div { padding: 0 0 22px; color: var(--color-muted); max-width: 70ch; }

.quote { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.quote blockquote { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.quote figcaption { font-size: .875rem; color: var(--color-muted); }

.cta-panel { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: grid; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 56px); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass); color: var(--color-text); background:
  radial-gradient(55% 90% at 100% 0%, rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .38), transparent 65%),
  radial-gradient(45% 80% at 0% 100%, rgb(var(--glow-mint) / .38), transparent 65%),
  radial-gradient(40% 70% at 40% 0%, rgb(var(--glow-blush) / .32), transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(35% 60% at 75% 100%, rgb(var(--glow-peach) / .3), transparent 70%),
  var(--color-surface); }
.cta-panel::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background-image: linear-gradient(var(--color-grid) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-grid) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 48px 48px; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 50%, #000, transparent 80%); mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 50%, #000, transparent 80%); }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .cta-panel { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; } }
.cta-panel h2 { max-width: 20ch; }
.cta-panel p { margin-top: 12px; color: var(--color-muted); max-width: 52ch; }

.showcase { display: grid; gap: var(--gap); }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .showcase { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr .8fr; align-items: end; } }
.device { position: relative; border-radius: 22px; padding: 8px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 85%, #000), #000); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.device--browser { padding: 30px 8px 8px; border-radius: 16px; }
.device--browser::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 14px; width: 42px; height: 8px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 4px 4px, #ff6159 3.5px, transparent 4px), radial-gradient(circle at 21px 4px, #ffbd2e 3.5px, transparent 4px), radial-gradient(circle at 38px 4px, #28c941 3.5px, transparent 4px); }
.device__screen { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; }
.device--browser .device__screen { border-radius: 8px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10.5; }
.device--phone .device__screen { aspect-ratio: 9 / 18.5; border-radius: 16px; }
.device__screen iframe { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; border: 0; transform-origin: 0 0; pointer-events: none; }
.device figcaption, .showcase figcaption { margin-top: 12px; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--color-muted); }

.stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap); }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.stat { padding-left: 18px; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.stat b { display: block; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.3rem + 2vw, 2.8rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.04em; line-height: 1; }
.stat span { font-size: .875rem; color: var(--color-muted); }

.prose { max-width: 70ch; }
.prose h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 2em 0 .6em; }
.prose h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 1.6em 0 .5em; }
.prose p, .prose ul, .prose ol { margin: 0 0 1em; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 86%, var(--color-muted)); }
.prose li + li { margin-top: .35em; }

/* 10. Forms ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.form { display: grid; gap: 20px; }
.form-row { display: grid; gap: 16px; align-content: start; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .form-row--2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .form-row--3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .form-row--4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.field { display: grid; gap: 7px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.field > label, .label { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; }
.field .req { color: var(--color-accent-text); }
.hint { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.input, .select, .textarea {
  width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font-size: 1rem;
  transition: border-color var(--t-fast), box-shadow var(--t-fast);
}
.input--sm, .select--sm { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: .9375rem; }
.textarea { min-height: 120px; resize: vertical; line-height: 1.5; }
.select { appearance: none; padding-right: 40px; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, currentColor 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, currentColor 50%, transparent 50%); background-position: calc(100% - 20px) 50%, calc(100% - 15px) 50%; background-size: 5px 5px; background-repeat: no-repeat; }
.input:hover, .select:hover, .textarea:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong); }
.input:focus, .select:focus, .textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 9%, transparent); }
.field.has-error .input, .field.has-error .select, .field.has-error .textarea { border-color: var(--error); }
.field-error { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--error); }
.form-errors { padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--error) 8%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--error) 30%, transparent); color: var(--error); font-size: .9375rem; }
.form-errors ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.check { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding-top: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: .9375rem; }
.check input { appearance: none; flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: 0; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); background: var(--color-surface); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--t-fast), border-color var(--t-fast); }
.check input::after { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 11px; border: solid #fff; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; rotate: 45deg; translate: 0 -1px; opacity: 0; }
.check input:checked { background: var(--control-on); border-color: var(--control-on); }
.check input:checked::after { opacity: 1; }
.check input[type="radio"] { border-radius: 50%; }
.check input[type="radio"]::after { width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; rotate: 0deg; translate: 0 0; }
.choice-grid { display: grid; gap: 10px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); }
.choice { position: relative; }
.choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.choice > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-surface); font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color var(--t-fast), box-shadow var(--t-fast), background-color var(--t-fast); }
.choice > span small { font-weight: 400; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .8125rem; }
.choice input:checked + span { border-color: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 22%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-soft) 55%, var(--color-surface)); }
.choice input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; font-size: .9375rem; }
.switch input { appearance: none; position: relative; flex: none; width: 48px; height: 28px; margin: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-border-strong); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--t-fast); }
.switch input::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .25); transition: translate var(--t-move) var(--ease-out); }
.switch input:checked { background: var(--control-on); }
.switch input:checked::after { translate: 20px 0; }
.color-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 6px 12px 6px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--color-surface); }
.color-field input[type="color"] { width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
.color-field input[type="color"]::-webkit-color-swatch-wrapper { padding: 0; }
.color-field input[type="color"]::-webkit-color-swatch { border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 9px; }
.color-field input[type="text"] { border: 0; background: none; width: 100%; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: .875rem; min-height: 36px; }
.file-drop { display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 22px; border: 1.5px dashed var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); text-align: center; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 70%, transparent); font-size: .9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color var(--t-fast), background-color var(--t-fast); }
.file-drop:hover, .file-drop.is-over { border-color: var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-accent-soft); }
.file-drop input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }
.repeat { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.repeat__row { display: grid; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--color-surface); }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .repeat__row { grid-template-columns: var(--cols, repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))) 44px; } }
.repeat__row .btn--icon { align-self: end; }
.hp { position: absolute !important; left: -9999px !important; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; }
fieldset { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; min-width: 0; }
legend { padding: 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }

/* 11. Notices, toasts, empty states -------------------------------------------------------- */
.toasts { position: fixed; z-index: 120; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; display: grid; gap: 10px; width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 32px)); }
.toast { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: .9375rem; animation: toast-in 500ms var(--ease-out); }
.toast .i { margin-top: 2px; }
.toast--success .i { color: var(--success); }
.toast--error .i { color: var(--error); }
.toast--info .i { color: var(--color-accent-text); }
.toast button { margin-left: auto; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; opacity: .6; width: 28px; height: 28px; }
@keyframes toast-in { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 10px; } }
.notice { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); font-size: .9375rem; }
.notice .i { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--color-accent-text); }
.notice--warn { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 7%, var(--color-surface)); }
.notice--warn .i { color: var(--warn); }
.notice--error { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--error) 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--error) 6%, var(--color-surface)); }
.notice--success { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 6%, var(--color-surface)); }
.notice--success .i { color: var(--success); }
.empty { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: clamp(32px, 6vw, 64px) 20px; text-align: center; border: 1px dashed var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
.empty .icon-tile { width: 64px; height: 64px; }
.empty p { max-width: 46ch; color: var(--color-muted); }

/* 12. Auth -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.auth { min-height: 100vh; display: grid; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .auth { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); } }
.auth__form { display: grid; align-content: center; padding: calc(var(--header-h) + 24px) var(--gutter) 48px; }
.auth__form > div { width: min(100%, 440px); margin-inline: auto; }
.auth__form h1 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.4rem + 2vw, 2.6rem); }
.auth__art { display: none; position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .auth__art { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 48px; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-line); background:
  radial-gradient(55% 45% at 80% 15%, rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .42), transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(50% 45% at 15% 30%, rgb(var(--glow-blush) / .38), transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(55% 50% at 70% 90%, rgb(var(--glow-mint) / .38), transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(40% 40% at 20% 85%, rgb(var(--glow-sky) / .36), transparent 70%), var(--color-bg); } }
.auth__quote { max-width: 440px; color: var(--color-text); }
.auth__quote p { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 2.2rem; line-height: 1.15; }

/* 13. App shell (dashboard + admin) -------------------------------------------------------- */
.app { display: grid; min-height: 100vh; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .app { grid-template-columns: 264px minmax(0, 1fr); } }
.sidebar { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 18px 14px; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 70%, transparent); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); overflow-y: auto; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .sidebar { display: flex; } }
.sidebar .brand { padding: 6px 10px 16px; }
.side-group { margin-top: 10px; }
.side-group__label { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-muted); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.side-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 78%, transparent); transition: background-color var(--t-fast), color var(--t-fast); }
.side-link .i { width: 18px; height: 18px; opacity: .8; }
.side-link:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 6%, transparent); color: var(--color-text); }
.side-link[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.side-link[aria-current="page"] .i { color: var(--color-accent-text); opacity: 1; }
.side-link .lock { margin-left: auto; width: 14px; height: 14px; opacity: .5; }
.side-event { margin: 4px 0 6px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); }
.side-event b { display: block; font-size: .9375rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; line-height: 1.3; }
.side-event span { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.sidebar__foot { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.topbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 64px; padding: 0 var(--gutter); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--glass-strong); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.4); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.4); }
.topbar .brand { display: inline-flex; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .topbar .brand { display: none; } }
.topbar__actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.app-main { min-width: 0; }
.app-content { padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px) var(--gutter) 64px; max-width: 1240px; }
.page-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.page-head h1 { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 1.2rem + 1.4vw, 2.2rem); letter-spacing: -.04em; }
.page-head p { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--color-muted); }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; margin-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.tabs a { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-muted); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; }
.tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--color-text); border-color: var(--color-accent); }
.kpis { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--n, 4), minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.kpi { padding: 18px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi); }
.kpi span { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.kpi b { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1vw, 2rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.04em; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.kpi small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.kpi--accent { background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-soft) 80%, var(--color-surface)), var(--color-surface)); }
.box { padding: var(--pad-card); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi); min-width: 0; }
.box__head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.box__head h2 { font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.cols { display: grid; gap: var(--gap); }
@media (min-width: 1100px) { .cols--2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr); } .cols--even { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.progress { height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface-2); overflow: hidden; }
.progress > span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--grad); transition: width 900ms var(--ease-out); }
.bar-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.bar-list__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 6px 12px; font-size: .9375rem; }
.bar-list__row .progress { grid-column: 1 / -1; height: 6px; }
.event-card { display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.event-card__top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; }
.event-card__meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.list-plain { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.list-rows > li { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); font-size: .9375rem; }
.list-rows > li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 36%) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; font-size: .9375rem; }
.dl dt, .dl dd { margin: 0; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.dl dt { color: var(--color-muted); }
.chart-bars { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; height: 160px; padding-top: 10px; }
.chart-bars div { flex: 1; min-width: 6px; border-radius: 6px 6px 2px 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-accent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 35%, transparent)); position: relative; }
.chart-bars div span { position: absolute; bottom: -22px; left: 50%; translate: -50% 0; font-size: .6875rem; color: var(--color-muted); white-space: nowrap; }
.app-drawer-nav .side-link { color: var(--band-text); }
.app-drawer-nav .side-group__label { color: var(--band-muted); }

/* 14. Tables ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface); }
.table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .9375rem; }
.table th { position: sticky; top: 0; text-align: left; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-muted); padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); white-space: nowrap; }
.table td { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); vertical-align: middle; }
.table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.table tbody tr:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 2.5%, transparent); }
.table .num { text-align: right; }
.table a { text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; }
.table a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.table__sub { display: block; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.toolbar .input, .toolbar .select { min-height: 42px; padding-block: 8px; width: auto; }
.toolbar .grow { flex: 1 1 220px; }

/* 15. Wizard ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.wizard { display: grid; gap: var(--gap); grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.wizard > *, .wizard-split > * { min-width: 0; }
@media (min-width: 1200px) { .wizard { grid-template-columns: 250px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; } }
.stepper { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
@media (min-width: 1200px) { .stepper { position: sticky; top: 88px; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } }
.stepper a { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--color-muted); white-space: nowrap; }
.stepper a:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 5%, transparent); color: var(--color-text); }
.stepper .n { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); font: 500 .75rem/1 var(--font-mono); }
.stepper .is-done .n { background: var(--color-accent-soft); border-color: transparent; color: var(--color-accent-text); }
.stepper a[aria-current="step"] { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); box-shadow: var(--inset-hi); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); font-weight: 500; }
.stepper a[aria-current="step"] .n { background: var(--btn-bg); background-image: var(--gold-sheen); border-color: transparent; color: var(--btn-text); }
.wizard-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--color-muted); margin-bottom: 18px; }
.wizard-progress .progress { flex: 1; }
.wizard-card { padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); }
.wizard-card h2 { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 1.1rem + 1vw, 1.9rem); }
.wizard-card > p.lead { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 1rem; }
.wizard-actions { position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin: 28px calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px)) calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px)); padding: 14px clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 88%, transparent); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4); }
.wizard-split { display: grid; gap: var(--gap); align-items: start; }
@media (min-width: 1600px) { .wizard-split { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); } .wizard-split .preview-frame { position: sticky; top: 80px; } }
.preview-frame { border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-surface-2); }
.preview-frame__bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px 8px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); font-size: .8125rem; }
.preview-frame__url { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--color-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.preview-frame__stage { display: grid; place-items: start center; padding: 16px; height: 720px; overflow: hidden; }
.preview-frame__stage iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: width var(--t-move) var(--ease-out); }
.preview-frame[data-device="mobile"] iframe { width: 390px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 28px; border: 8px solid #141213; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface-2); }
.seg button, .seg a { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.seg [aria-pressed="true"], .seg [aria-current="page"] { background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); }
.palette-swatches { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.palette-swatches i { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / .1); }
.review-section { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.review-section__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.review-section h3 { font-size: 1.0625rem; }

/* 16. Seating editor ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.seating { display: grid; gap: var(--gap); }
@media (min-width: 1100px) { .seating { grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; } }
.seat-pool { position: sticky; top: 80px; max-height: calc(100vh - 100px); overflow: auto; }
.seat-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); font-size: .875rem; cursor: grab; user-select: none; }
.seat-chip:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.seat-chip.is-dragging { opacity: .4; }
.seat-chip .party { font: 500 .75rem/1 var(--font-mono); color: var(--color-muted); }
.seat-chip.is-selected { border-color: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 22%, transparent); }
.floor { position: relative; min-height: 640px; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); overflow: hidden; background-color: var(--color-surface); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--color-grid) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-grid) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px; }
.floor__label { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 14px; translate: -50% 0; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); }
.s-table { position: absolute; width: 150px; translate: -50% -50%; display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 20px; text-align: center; cursor: move; touch-action: none; transition: box-shadow var(--t-fast), border-color var(--t-fast); }
.s-table.is-over { border-color: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 25%, transparent), var(--shadow-glass); }
.s-table.is-full .s-table__occ { color: var(--warn); }
.s-table.is-over-cap .s-table__occ { color: var(--error); }
.s-table__ring { width: 74px; height: 74px; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: conic-gradient(var(--color-accent) calc(var(--fill, 0) * 1%), var(--color-surface-2) 0); }
.s-table--long .s-table__ring { width: 110px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-accent) calc(var(--fill, 0) * 1%), var(--color-surface-2) 0); }
.s-table__ring > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: calc(100% - 10px); height: calc(100% - 10px); border-radius: inherit; background: var(--color-surface); font: 600 .8125rem/1 var(--font-mono); }
.s-table__name { font-weight: 600; font-size: .875rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.s-table__occ { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.s-table ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 3px; max-height: 120px; overflow: auto; text-align: left; }
.s-table li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: .75rem; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-bg); cursor: grab; }
.s-table li button { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 2px; opacity: .55; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1; min-width: 20px; min-height: 20px; }
.seat-list-view { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); }

/* 17. Footer ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.site-footer { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; margin-top: var(--section-y); padding: clamp(48px, 7vw, 80px) 0 28px; background: radial-gradient(45% 60% at 100% 0%, rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .28), transparent 65%), radial-gradient(40% 55% at 0% 100%, rgb(var(--glow-blush) / .18), transparent 65%), radial-gradient(30% 40% at 55% 100%, rgb(var(--glow-mint) / .12), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--band-bg-2), var(--band-bg)); color: var(--band-text); }
.site-footer::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(255 255 255 / .035) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .035) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 64px 64px; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #000, transparent 70%); mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #000, transparent 70%); }
.footer-grid { display: grid; gap: 32px; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.footer-grid > :first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; } .footer-grid > :first-child { grid-column: auto; } }
.site-footer h3 { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--band-text); }
.site-footer ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.site-footer li a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / .78); text-decoration: none; font-size: .9375rem; }
.site-footer li a:hover { color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; }
.footer-bottom { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-top: 40px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--band-line); font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--band-muted); }
.socials { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.socials a { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--band-line); color: var(--band-text); }
.socials a:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .6); }
.wordmark-giant { margin-top: 32px; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-style: italic; font-size: min(14rem, (100vw - 2 * var(--gutter)) / 4.1); line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.03em; color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgb(255 255 255 / .14); user-select: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.wordmark-giant span { -webkit-text-stroke-color: rgb(var(--glow-accent) / .55); }

/* 18. Motion ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.js [data-reveal] { opacity: 0; translate: 0 12px; transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease), translate var(--dur) var(--ease), transform var(--t-move) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--t-fast), box-shadow var(--t-move) var(--ease-out); }
.js [data-reveal].is-visible { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; }
.hero-enter > * { animation: rise 900ms var(--ease-out) both; }
.hero-enter > :nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .08s; }
.hero-enter > :nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .2s; }
.hero-enter > :nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .3s; }
.hero-enter > :nth-child(5) { animation-delay: .5s; }
@keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 22px; } }
.orbit { animation: swell 1.6s var(--ease-out) both .2s; }
@keyframes swell { from { opacity: 0; scale: .94; } }
.orbit__lines path { animation: dash 24s linear infinite; }
@keyframes dash { to { stroke-dashoffset: -180; } }
@keyframes bob { 50% { translate: 0 -6px; } }
.float-tile { animation: bob 7s ease-in-out infinite; }
.float-tile--seat { animation-delay: -2s; }
.float-tile--menu { animation-delay: -4s; }
.float-tile--link { animation-delay: -5.5s; }
.spinner { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-right-color: transparent; animation: spin .8s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { rotate: 360deg; } }

/* 19. Phones: one centred column (marketing pages only) ------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .site main { text-align: center; }
  .site main :is(form, .prose, .faq, .price ul, .price__limits, .compare, article, .notice, .table-wrap) { text-align: left; }
  .site main :is(.section-head__intro, .lead, .hero__sub, .hero__title, .page-hero h1) { margin-inline: auto; }
  .site main .section-head h2::after { margin-inline: auto; }
  .site main .btn-row, .site main .hero__note, .site main .cluster, .site main .breadcrumbs { justify-content: center; }
  .site main .btn-row .btn { width: min(100%, 340px); }
  .site main .icon-tile { margin-inline: auto; }
  .site main .stat { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; }
  .steps { justify-items: center; }
  .step { padding-top: 30px; text-align: center; }
  .step::before { left: 50%; translate: -50% 0; }
  .step::after { display: none; }
  .site main .chips-scroll { flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; padding-bottom: 4px; }
  .site main .chips-scroll > * { flex: none; }
  .site main .chips-scroll > :first-child { margin-left: auto; }
  .site main .chips-scroll > :last-child { margin-right: auto; }
  .cat-tile { text-align: center; align-items: center; }
  .footer-grid { text-align: left; }
}

/* 20. Print + reduced motion ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media print {
  .site-header, .sidebar, .topbar, .site-footer, .no-print, .toasts { display: none !important; }
  body { background: #fff; }
  .app { display: block; }
  .box, .table-wrap { box-shadow: none; border-color: #ccc; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
  .js [data-reveal] { opacity: 1; translate: none; }
}

/* Small-screen helpers */
@media (max-width: 559px) { .hide-sm { display: none !important; } }

/* Pricing comparison: scrolls in its own box on phones, sticky header from 900px */
.table-wrap--sticky { overflow-x: auto; }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .table-wrap--sticky { overflow: visible; } }

/* Phones: the wizard save bar sits at the end of the form instead of covering it */
@media (max-width: 767px) { .wizard-actions { position: static; } }
```

### `static/css/eventsite.css`

<!-- FILE: static/css/eventsite.css sha256=0a8f5c8b2537335086ee3d1b89af7f3ba8e6280c6e9cb61de09c53c85ceeaa86 nl=1 -->
```css
/* Aurelia event websites: shared base + eleven designs (scoped by .d-<design>).
   Theme variables come from the event: --ev-bg --ev-surface --ev-text --ev-muted --ev-accent
   --ev-accent2 --ev-display --ev-body, plus contrast-checked --ev-btn --ev-btn-text --ev-ink. */

/* ---------- base ---------- */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-padding-top: 80px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } }
.ev {
  --ev-btn: var(--ev-text); --ev-btn-text: var(--ev-bg); --ev-ink: var(--ev-text); --ev-ink-s: var(--ev-ink);
  --ev-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 14%, transparent);
  --ev-radius: 14px; --ev-pad: clamp(20px, 4vw, 40px); --ev-w: 1120px;
  margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; overflow-x: clip;
  background: var(--ev-bg); color: var(--ev-text);
  font: 400 clamp(1rem, .96rem + .2vw, 1.0625rem)/1.65 var(--ev-body);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.ev img { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.ev a { color: inherit; }
.ev h1, .ev h2, .ev h3, .ev h4 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; text-wrap: balance; }
.ev h2 { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 1.3rem + 2vw, 2.75rem); }
.ev h3 { font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 1.05rem + .6vw, 1.5rem); }
.ev h4 { font-family: var(--ev-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; }
.ev p { margin: 0; text-wrap: pretty; }
.ev :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-ink); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }
.ev .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
.ev .mono { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.ev-skip { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: -60px; z-index: 50; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text); border-radius: 999px; }
.ev-skip:focus { top: 12px; }
.ev-banner { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; padding: 8px 16px; text-align: center; font: 500 .8125rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; background: #1B191A; color: #F5F3F2; }
.ev-banner--notice { background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text); }
.ev-ribbon { position: fixed; z-index: 40; top: 14px; right: -42px; rotate: 45deg; width: 170px; padding: 6px 0; text-align: center; font: 600 .6875rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #1B191A; color: #F5F3F2; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / .2); pointer-events: none; }

.ev-sec { position: relative; padding: clamp(48px, 8vw, 96px) var(--ev-pad); }
.ev-sec__in { max-width: var(--ev-w); margin-inline: auto; }
.ev-h { margin-bottom: clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px); }
.ev-kicker { font-family: var(--ev-body); font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-ink); margin-bottom: 10px !important; }
.ev-lead { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 1.1rem + 1.1vw, 2rem); line-height: 1.35; max-width: 32ch; }
.ev-text { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 88%, var(--ev-muted)); max-width: 62ch; }
.ev-text + .ev-text, .ev-lead + .ev-text { margin-top: 16px; }
.ev-small { font-size: .9375rem; }
.ev-muted { color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-greet { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-style: italic; font-size: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 8px !important; }

.ev-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5em; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text) !important; font: 600 .9375rem/1 var(--ev-body); letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .35s, background-color .18s; }
.ev-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / .5); }
.ev-btn:active { transform: scale(.98); }
.ev-btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ev-text) !important; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 28%, transparent); }
.ev-btn--ghost:hover { border-color: var(--ev-text); box-shadow: none; }
.ev-btn--sm { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: .875rem; }
.ev-btn--wide { width: 100%; }
.ev-btn[disabled] { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
.ev-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; }

.ev-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30; padding: 6px var(--ev-pad); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-bg) 88%, transparent); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-nav ul { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0; max-width: var(--ev-w); list-style: none; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ev-nav ul::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.ev-nav li:first-child { margin-left: auto; }
.ev-nav li:last-child { margin-right: auto; }
.ev-nav a { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; opacity: .8; border-radius: 999px; }
.ev-nav a:hover { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 7%, transparent); }
.ev-nav__n { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--ev-ink); }

.ev-when { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 24px 0 0; }
.ev-when div { display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.ev-when dt { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-when dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }

.ev-count { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(8px, 2vw, 18px); max-width: 640px; }
.ev-count__cell { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: clamp(14px, 3vw, 24px) 6px; border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-count__cell b { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.2rem + 3vw, 3.25rem); line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ev-count__cell span { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-count__done { margin-top: 12px !important; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.25rem; }

.ev-venue__name { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 1.1rem + 1.2vw, 2rem); }
.ev-venue__addr { margin-top: 6px !important; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-venue__time { margin-top: 6px !important; font-weight: 500; }
.ev-notes { display: grid; gap: 16px; margin-top: 28px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-notes { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.ev-note { padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-surface) 80%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-note h4 { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.ev-note + .ev-note { margin-top: 0; }
.ev-sec__body > .ev-note { margin-top: 18px; }
.ev-funcs { list-style: none; margin: 28px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-funcs { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); } }
.ev-func { display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; padding: 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-func__when { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ev-ink-s); }
.ev-func__venue { color: var(--ev-muted); font-size: .9375rem; }
.ev-func .ev-btn { justify-self: start; margin-top: 6px; }

.ev-prog__group { margin: 28px 0 12px; font-size: 1.125rem; }
.ev-prog__group:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.ev-prog { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; }
.ev-prog__item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-prog__item time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ev-ink); letter-spacing: .04em; }
.ev-prog__item h4 { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.15rem; }

.ev-menu + .ev-menu { margin-top: 32px; }
.ev-menu__name { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.ev-menu__course { margin: 22px 0 8px; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-ink); }
.ev-menu__items { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.ev-menu__dish { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.2rem; }
.ev-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; }
.ev-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 500; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 14%, transparent); color: var(--ev-text); }
.ev-tag--choice { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-dress { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1.4vw, 2.4rem); margin-bottom: 10px !important; }

.ev-table { display: grid; gap: 6px; justify-items: start; padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-table__name { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.4rem + 2vw, 2.8rem); line-height: 1.1; }

.ev-list { list-style: none; margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-list--reg { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); } }
.ev-list li { padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; }
.ev-list li .ev-btn { justify-self: start; margin-top: 6px; }
.ev-list a { text-underline-offset: .2em; }
.ev-contacts { list-style: none; margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-contacts { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); } }
.ev-contacts li { padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-contacts .ev-actions { margin-top: 10px; gap: 6px; }

.ev-gal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-gal { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.ev-gal__item { position: relative; margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 18%, var(--ev-surface)); }
.ev-gal__item:nth-child(5n+1) { grid-row: span 2; aspect-ratio: auto; }
.ev-gal__item img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: scale .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
.ev-gal__item:hover img { scale: 1.03; }
.ev-gal__item figcaption { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: .8125rem; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgb(0 0 0 / .55)); }
.ev-gal__art { min-height: 140px; }
.ev-art-0 { background: radial-gradient(80% 60% at 30% 90%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 55%, transparent), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(160deg, var(--ev-surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 40%, var(--ev-bg))); }
.ev-art-1 { background: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 70% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 60%, transparent), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(200deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 30%, var(--ev-bg)), var(--ev-surface)); }
.ev-art-2 { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 18%, transparent) 0 2px, transparent 2px 14px), var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-art-3 { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 60%, transparent) 0 35%, transparent 36%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 50%, transparent) 0 55%, transparent 56%), var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-art-4 { background: conic-gradient(from 200deg at 30% 70%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 40%, var(--ev-bg)), var(--ev-surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 45%, var(--ev-bg)), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 40%, var(--ev-bg))); }
.ev-art-5 { background: linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 35%, var(--ev-surface)) 0 30%, var(--ev-surface) 30%), var(--ev-surface); }

/* forms */
.ev-rsvp { display: grid; gap: 18px; max-width: 640px; }
.ev-rsvp fieldset { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.ev-rsvp__note { color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-rsvp__as { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 12%, transparent); }
.ev-grid2 { display: grid; gap: 18px; }
@media (min-width: 620px) { .ev-grid2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: start; } }
.ev-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.ev-field label, .ev-choice legend { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; }
.ev-input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 24%, transparent); background: var(--ev-surface); color: var(--ev-text); font: 400 1rem/1.4 var(--ev-body); }
textarea.ev-input { min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; }
select.ev-input { appearance: none; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, currentColor 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, currentColor 50%, transparent 50%); background-position: calc(100% - 20px) 50%, calc(100% - 15px) 50%; background-size: 5px 5px; background-repeat: no-repeat; padding-right: 40px; }
.ev-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ev-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 12%, transparent); }
.ev-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #B42318; }
.ev-hint { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-err { font-size: .8125rem; color: #B42318; font-weight: 600; }
.ev-errors { padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(180 35 24 / .35); background: rgb(180 35 24 / .08); color: #8F1C13; font-size: .9375rem; }
.ev-errors ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.ev-choice { display: flex !important; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px !important; }
.ev-choice legend { width: 100%; margin-bottom: 8px; float: left; }
.ev-radio, .ev-check { position: relative; display: inline-flex; }
.ev-radio input, .ev-check input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; cursor: pointer; margin: 0; }
.ev-radio span, .ev-check span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 24%, transparent); background: var(--ev-surface); font-weight: 500; font-size: .9375rem; transition: background-color .18s, color .18s, border-color .18s; }
.ev-check span { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: .875rem; }
.ev-radio input:checked + span, .ev-check input:checked + span { background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text); border-color: transparent; }
.ev-radio input:focus-visible + span, .ev-check input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }
.ev-attending { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 18px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px dashed var(--ev-line); }
.ev-attending[hidden] { display: none; }
.ev-hp { position: absolute !important; left: -9999px; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; }
.ev-thanks { display: grid; gap: 10px; justify-items: start; max-width: 560px; padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: var(--ev-surface); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-thanks h3 { font-size: 1.6rem; }
.ev-thanks:focus { outline: none; }

.ev-photo { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 20%, var(--ev-surface)); }
.ev-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.ev-photo--art { background: radial-gradient(70% 60% at 30% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 45%, transparent), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(50% 50% at 80% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 45%, transparent), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(170deg, var(--ev-surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 12%, var(--ev-bg))); }

.ev-mono { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 92px; height: 92px; margin: 0 auto 24px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--ev-accent); font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.6rem; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--ev-ink); position: relative; }
.ev-mono::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 5px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 45%, transparent); }
.ev-mono--logo { border: 0; width: 120px; height: auto; }
.ev-mono--logo::after { display: none; }

.ev-foot { padding: 56px var(--ev-pad) 40px; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-foot > p:first-child { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.4rem; }
.ev-made { margin-top: 18px !important; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.ev-made a { color: var(--ev-muted); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
.ev-made a:hover { color: var(--ev-text); }

.orn { display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.orn g, .orn path { stroke: currentColor; }

/* background modes */
.bg-paper { background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 5%, transparent) .6px, transparent .7px), radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 3%, transparent) .6px, transparent .7px); background-size: 7px 7px, 11px 11px; background-position: 0 0, 3px 5px; }

/* simple themed pages */
.ev-simple { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; }
.ev-simple__card { max-width: 560px; padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 48px); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--ev-surface); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); display: grid; gap: 16px; text-align: center; justify-items: center; }
.ev-simple__card h1 { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.4rem + 1.5vw, 2.4rem); }
.ev-simple:not([style]) { --ev-bg: #F5F5F4; --ev-surface: #fff; --ev-text: #1B191A; --ev-muted: #625D5E; --ev-accent: #B08D45; --ev-btn: #8A6B2C; --ev-btn-text: #fff; --ev-display: Georgia, serif; --ev-body: system-ui, sans-serif; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 1. ATELIER: minimalist luxury, one calm centred column, hairlines                            */
.d-atelier { --ev-w: 680px; }
.at-hero { min-height: 92svh; display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 72px var(--ev-pad) 56px; }
.at-names { font-size: clamp(3rem, 1.6rem + 7vw, 6.5rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.01em; display: grid; justify-items: center; }
.at-names .ev-amp { font-style: italic; font-size: .5em; color: var(--ev-ink); margin: 10px 0; }
.at-rule { width: 1px; height: 64px; margin: 28px auto; background: linear-gradient(var(--ev-accent), transparent); }
.at-date { font-size: .875rem; letter-spacing: .32em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.at-place { margin: 8px 0 30px !important; color: var(--ev-muted); font-family: var(--ev-display); font-style: italic; font-size: 1.15rem; }
.at-nav { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-bg) 92%, transparent); }
.at-nav a { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.at-photo { max-width: 920px; margin: 48px auto 0; padding: 0 var(--ev-pad); }
.at-photo .ev-photo { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.at-col { padding-bottom: 24px; }
.at-sec { text-align: center; }
.at-sec + .at-sec::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; width: 9px; height: 9px; translate: -50% -50%; rotate: 45deg; border: 1px solid var(--ev-accent); background: var(--ev-bg); }
.at-sec + .at-sec { border-top: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.at-sec .ev-h h2 { font-weight: 300; font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 2vw, 3rem); }
.at-sec .ev-kicker { display: none; }
.at-sec .ev-lead, .at-sec .ev-text { margin-inline: auto; }
.at-sec .ev-actions, .at-sec .ev-choice { justify-content: center; }
.at-sec .ev-prog__item, .at-sec .ev-rsvp, .at-sec .ev-list li, .at-sec .ev-contacts li, .at-sec .ev-note, .at-sec .ev-func { text-align: left; }
.at-sec .ev-rsvp, .at-sec .ev-count, .at-sec .ev-thanks { margin-inline: auto; }
.at-sec .ev-count__cell { border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--ev-line); border-radius: 0; background: none; }
.at-sec .ev-count__cell:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.at-sec .ev-count__cell b { font-weight: 300; }
.d-atelier .ev-btn { border-radius: 0; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .75rem; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 30px; }
.d-atelier .ev-note, .d-atelier .ev-func, .d-atelier .ev-list li, .d-atelier .ev-contacts li, .d-atelier .ev-table { border-radius: 0; background: transparent; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 2. FOLIO: modern editorial magazine spread, oversized headline, sticky index                */
.d-folio { --ev-radius: 0; }
.fo-hero { padding: 18px var(--ev-pad) clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px); border-bottom: 3px double var(--ev-text); }
.fo-mast { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-text); font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; }
.fo-mast span:first-child { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-style: italic; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: none; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; }
.fo-hero__grid { display: grid; gap: 32px; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
@media (min-width: 960px) { .fo-hero__grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, .75fr); align-items: end; } }
.fo-title { font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 1.4rem + 9vw, 9.5rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: .86; letter-spacing: -.045em; display: grid; }
.fo-title .ev-amp { font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ev-accent); font-size: .6em; line-height: 1; margin-left: .4em; }
.fo-deck { margin-top: 26px !important; max-width: 40ch; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 1rem + .5vw, 1.35rem); line-height: 1.45; border-left: 3px solid var(--ev-accent); padding-left: 16px; }
.fo-hero__fig { margin: 0; }
.fo-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; filter: grayscale(.15) contrast(1.05); }
```
